gem:ria-sirach: Village by Prades in the Conflent, close to Saint-Michel de Cuxa and Villefranche-de-Conflent; a base, with little of its own.
gem:luttringen: Rural village 8 km from the Möhne reservoir and the Werl pilgrimage basilica; nothing of its own to visit.
gem:cullera: Beach town under the Castell de Cullera and its sanctuary; high-rises line the shore and limit the appeal.
gem:forlev: Rural village by Trelleborg, a UNESCO-listed Viking ring fortress, with Antvorskov abbey ruins nearby; the fort is the only reason to come.
gem:vaxjo: Småland city with its cathedral and the Småland museum; a pleasant stop, little to fill a second day.
gem:ponferrada: City with a great castle, a clock tower and the Encina basilica; the castle earns a stop, the modern town around it less.
gem:villeloin-coulange: Indrois valley village near Montrésor's château and the Villiers priory; the card mixes in its listed neighbour, and it offers little itself.
gem:savennieres: Loire wine village with an old church and windmill, the Château de Serrant 7 km away; a pleasant stop among vineyards.
gem:moulins-le-carbonnel: Normandy-border village in both Plus Beaux Villages and Petites Cités de Caractère, with the Auberge des Peintres; tiny.
gem:ermelo: Veluwe town beside the Veluwemeer and Wolderwijd lakes; green and calm, but with few sights in town.
gem:jerica: Small Valencian hill village in a protected historic grouping with a Mudejar tower; Segorbe cathedral lies 10 km away.
gem:limerick: King John's Castle, two cathedrals and the Hunt Museum give a solid half day; the wider city fabric is plain.
gem:armacao-de-pera: Algarve beach resort five kilometres from Praia da Marinha's cliffs and coves; a good beach base, with a built-up seafront.
gem:campo-ligure: Listed valley village with a castle and a filigree museum, the Beigua park close by; an hour or two, then the hills.
gem:milano-marittima: Adriatic beach resort set among pine woods, with the Cervia salt pans and reserves nearby; seaside leisure, few real sights.
gem:taranto: The MArTA archaeological museum, the Aragonese castle and the cathedral of San Cataldo; a worn port city, a day is enough.
gem:guardiagrele: Listed hill village under the Maiella with Santa Maria Maggiore and a cathedral museum; a good half day, quiet after that.
gem:civitella-del-tronto: Listed hilltop village at 589 m facing the Montagna dei Fiori and the Salinello gorges; most named sights lie 5 km off.
gem:mailly-maillet: Somme village a few kilometres from the Newfoundland and Thiepval memorials; a base for the battlefields, little in the village itself.
gem:nykoping: Town with Nyköping Castle and the Sörmland Museum beside it; a few hours, then little more.
gem:bard: Tiny Aosta Valley village below a large fortress that houses the Alps museum; the fort is the visit, little else.
gem:prudhomat: Home of the red Château de Castelnau-Bretenoux, with the Gouffre de Padirac 7 km away; the village is small and quiet.
gem:bran: Village below the hilltop Bran Castle with the Piatra Craiului and gorges nearby; busy with visitors, thin beyond the castle.
gem:combles: Somme village among First World War memorials and cemeteries, including Delville Wood; a remembrance stop, not a place to stay.
gem:limin-mesoyaias: Harbour town at Porto Rafti with the Brauron sanctuary of Artemis 4 km away; a seaside escape from Athens, little in town.
gem:ostseebad-binz: Baltic resort with a white Kurhaus, Jagdschloss Granitz and the Prora complex 5 km away; a fine seaside stay, busy in summer.
gem:jena: University city with the Zeiss Planetarium, the Optical Museum and the Jentower viewpoint; lively with students, modest historic fabric.
gem:tirrenia: Pine-backed beach resort near Livorno, whose forts lie 7 to 9 km away; beach days, little of its own.
gem:jaca: Pyrenean town at 830 m with a Romanesque cathedral and its Ciudadela fortress; a good half day and mountain base.
gem:kemmel: Flanders village beside Kemmelberg, ringed by First World War cemeteries; moving for history visitors, little else.
gem:baarn: Leafy town with Paleis Soestdijk and the Baarnse Bos; a pleasant walk rather than a destination.
gem:chatillon-sur-chalaronne: Listed Dombes town with its château ruins, the Porte de Villars and old houses; pretty for an hour or two, not more.
gem:arta: Greek town known for its arched Bridge of Arta, the Parigoritissa church and a castle; compact, with a low-key evening.
gem:varese: Lombard city with the Sacro Monte 5 km away; Lake Varese lies 7 km off, with lakes and peaks all around.
gem:nieuw-bergen: Maas valley village among woods and castles 3 to 9 km away; nothing of its own that makes it a destination.
gem:freiberg: Silver-mining town with its cathedral, Schloss Freudenstein and a mining museum; a full day of sights, quiet in the evening.
gem:lido-di-castel-fusano: Beach suburb 5 km from Ostia Antica and Portus; the ruins belong elsewhere and the shore is a busy city beach.
gem:bad-neuenahr-ahrweiler: Spa town in the Ahr wine valley with a Roman villa and castle ruins nearby; pleasant for a night, not a reason to travel.
gem:wilhelmshaven: North Sea naval port with a coastal museum, an art hall and Kniphausen castle nearby; functional and spread out.
gem:fougeres: Listed town with the great castle of Fougères and the Gothic Saint-Sulpice church below it; a strong half day in a quiet town.
gem:hameenlinna: Medieval Häme Castle by the lake and the Aulanko park 3 km away; the town centre is modest.
gem:santa-pola: Alicante fishing and beach town with a castle and old watchtowers along the coast; a resort, little to see beyond the beach.
gem:wei-enburg-in-bayern: Walled Franconian town with the Ellinger Tor, Roman baths and the Wülzburg fortress above; quiet, a half day to a day.
gem:sodertalje: Industrial city south of Stockholm with a few churches and a historic ship; more a commuter place than a reason to stop.
gem:le-bar-sur-loup: Listed hill village behind the Riviera with a church of its own; Grasse's cathedral and perfume sights are seven kilometres away.
gem:huskvarna: Lake Vättern shore with a beach 6 km off; the listed sights are suburban churches, so little reason to stay.
gem:sant-agata: Listed Mugello village 7 to 8 km from the Medici villas of Cafaggiolo and Trebbio, Lake Bilancino near; small in itself.
gem:sumeg: Hungarian hill town crowned by Sümeg Castle, with an episcopal palace below; compact, with little beyond the castle.
gem:bonnieux: Hill village close to Pont Julien, Lacoste and Lourmarin castles, a good touring base; the card names little inside the village.
gem:vila-do-conde: Portuguese coastal town on the Ave estuary with Lagoa and Aguçadoura beaches near; churches are modest and the card names no landmark.
gem:palena: Listed Abruzzo mountain village with a bear museum and hermitages nearby; remote and quiet, little to fill a full day.
gem:tonnerre: Burgundy town of character around the Fosse Dionne spring basin, with the Château de Tanlay 8 km away; a short stop, a quiet town.
gem:ribadavia: Listed Galician town with the Santo Domingo convent and an ethnographic museum, Melón monastery 7 km off; a half day.
gem:todi: Umbrian hill town with the Palazzo del Capitano and the domed Santa Maria della Consolazione below; a fine day, quiet at night.
gem:nodebo: Quiet village in the Gribskov woods with lakes nearby; the palaces are in neighbouring towns, not here.
gem:hameln: Weser Renaissance old town with the Hochzeitshaus and Hämelschenburg palace near; compact, seen well in a day.
gem:varberg: West coast town under Varberg Fortress, with the Halland museum and Apelviken beach 2.5 km off; a good summer day, little more.
gem:marienheide: Dispersed Bergisches Land municipality with a castle at Gimborn 5 km away; little town to speak of.
gem:gunzenhausen: Franconian town on the Altmühlsee lake, part of the UNESCO Roman frontier, with a Roman fort 7 km away; modest in scale.
gem:baden: Swiss spa town with the Museum Langmatt, Königsfelden abbey 7 km away; pleasant, but the card names few sights in town.
gem:termoli: Seaside town with a Swabian castle and cathedral in its old quarter by the shore; pleasant for a night, few other sights.
gem:recanati: Marche hill town with the Persiani theatre and Villa Colloredo museum, Loreto's sanctuary 6 km off; a half day.
gem:terezin: Fortress town with the Small Fortress and the National Cemetery, a sobering memorial; a half day, not a place to linger.
gem:neukirchen: Village on the edge of Chemnitz with the moated Klaffenbach castle; the other sights are in the city, not a destination.
gem:mytikas: Beach village by Monolithi beach, a few km from the Roman ruins of Nikopolis; a quiet seaside stop, the village itself is plain.
gem:chiusi: Hill town with the National Etruscan Museum and painted tombs such as the Tomba della Scimmia; a rewarding half day, quiet after.
gem:vitre: Castle and fortifications above timber-framed streets such as rue Baudrairie; a rewarding half day, not much more.
gem:l-ametlla-de-mar: Fishing coast of small coves such as Cala Forn, the Ebro delta's Punta del Fangar within reach; good for swimming, few sights.
gem:arnhem: Rhine city with Sonsbeek park, the John Frost Bridge, and the Open Air Museum and Burgers' Zoo 3 km out; the centre itself is plain.
gem:nieuwpoort: Coastal town with the Nieuport Memorial at the Ganzepoot locks and a beach 3 km off; the rest is a modern seaside town.
gem:ramatuelle: Listed hill village above Pampelonne beach, 7 km from Saint-Tropez; the village is small and the sights are in Saint-Tropez.
gem:cerveteri: UNESCO Etruscan necropolis of the Banditaccia with the Tomba dei Rilievi; a rewarding half day, though the modern town adds little.
gem:ornans: Listed small town with its old bridge, Saint-Laurent church and historic mansions; a pleasant stop rather than a full day.
gem:baiona: Listed historic harbour town on the Vigo estuary with beaches close by; most listed sights lie in nearby villages.
gem:dokkum: Frisian town with a historic core and windmills nearby; peaceful, with few sights to add.
gem:karlstad: Waterside Värmland city with a cathedral, county museum and town beaches; pleasant but plain, quickly done.
gem:deruta: Umbrian village in the Borghi più belli list, built around its regional ceramics museum and the Piazza dei Consoli; small.
gem:hagen: Ruhr city with the Osthaus museum, Hohenhof and lakes nearby; mostly postwar and industrial, few reasons to stay.
gem:portimao: Algarve base for Praia dos Três Irmãos and Praia da Marinha, 4 to 12 km off; the town itself is a busy resort.
gem:bad-kreuznach: Spa town with its old Nahe bridge and the Kauzenburg, Ebernburg castle 4 km away; a pleasant stop, short on more.
gem:guadalajara: Provincial city with the Palacio del Infantado and the Vega del Pozo foundation; a few fine buildings in an ordinary centre.
gem:sluis: Small border town a short ride from the Zwin and the Knokke beaches; its own sights fill only an afternoon.
gem:vielha: Listed mountain town in a Pyrenean biosphere reserve, Arties and Salardú nearby and the Aneto within reach; a base more than a sight.
gem:go-weinstein: Hill village surrounded by caves and castles such as Burg Pottenstein, a good walking base; its own core is small.
gem:alessandria: Plain Piedmont city with a star-shaped Cittadella and the Marengo Museum nearby; little that holds a visitor.
gem:ossana: Listed Val di Sole village at 1,003 m with castle and old churches under the Presanella; a short visit unless you hike.
gem:opole: Market square, cathedral and the Piast Tower in a mid-sized city; a pleasant afternoon, not a reason to travel.
gem:lucignano: Listed Tuscan hill village of old lanes and churches; small, and its main sights lie several kilometres out.
gem:alfeld: Leine valley town with the UNESCO-listed Fagus Factory, a landmark of modern architecture; one visit of an hour or two.
gem:castelsantangelo-sul-nera: Tiny national park village at 780 m under Monte Porche and Monte Argentella, Lago di Pilato 12 km off; for walkers, little in the village.
gem:busteni: Mountain town below the Bucegi walls and Caraiman Peak, near Peleș Castle and the Sphinx rock; a hiking base with a plain main road.
gem:sainte-maxime: Riviera beach town facing Saint-Tropez, with a promenade and the Tour Suffren; a seaside stay more than a sightseeing stop.
gem:vorden: Achterhoek village with Kasteel Hackfort, its mill and other castles within 5 km; quiet cycling country, little to fill a day.
gem:sitten: Valère basilica and Tourbillon castle above the old town and cathedral; a rewarding day, quiet in the evening.
gem:castelo-branco: Inland town with the baroque Episcopal Garden, a castle and a cathedral; a good half day, then little to keep you.
gem:la-spezia: Naval port city and handy base, with the Cinque Terre 8 km and Palmaria island 7 km away; its own centre is plain.
gem:monts-sur-guesnes: Small listed village with a manor and an old gatehouse; its notable churches lie up to 8 km away, little to stop for.
gem:imola: Rocca Sforzesca, Palazzo Tozzoni and the cathedral of San Cassiano; a solid half day, plain beyond the centre.
gem:montoire-sur-le-loir: Loir valley town with a castle ruin and the Château de Lavardin close by; a short stop rather than a place to stay.
gem:limin-khersonisou: Package resort strip with an aquarium and beaches; the Skotino cave and Chersonesos ruins lie outside, the place itself has little character.
gem:santa-margherita-ligure: Riviera harbour town at the foot of the Portofino promontory, near San Fruttuoso; a fine base, its own sights are modest.
gem:mseno: Small town in the Kokořín sandstone country near Kokořín and Houska castles; a base for walks, with little in the town.
gem:lampedusa: Remote island in a marine reserve with Rabbit Beach 5 km from town; superb water, but a plain town and little else to see.
gem:barruera: Mountain village at 1,100 m among the UNESCO Romanesque churches of the Vall de Boí; a fine base, itself small.
gem:venlo: Maas city with the Romerhuis, town hall and Sint-Martinusbasiliek; a compact core, quickly seen.
gem:o-grove: Peninsula town near A Lanzada beach and the Ría de Arousa; the historic sights are in Cambados next door.
gem:camigliatello-silano: Mountain resort in the Sila biosphere reserve near Lago Cecita, a base for forest walks; its listed museums are in Cosenza, 17 km off.
gem:mechernich: Eifel town with castles such as Burg Satzvey and the Stockert radio telescope within 7 km; little to see in town itself.
gem:frankfurt-oder: River border city with a few monuments and a Kleist museum; scattered sights and not much to hold a visit.
gem:protaras: Fig Tree Bay on its doorstep and Cape Greco 6 km away; a hotel strip with no town to speak of.
gem:hoxter: Town with UNESCO-listed Corvey abbey and a historic town hall; worth half a day, little to hold a second.
gem:marina-di-massa: Beach resort below the Apuan Alps with Massa's cathedral and Malaspina castle a few kilometres inland; a long resort strip.
gem:saint-die-des-vosges: Vosges town with a cathedral and a UNESCO-listed factory; interesting for architecture, though modest otherwise.
gem:aalen: Swabian town with a Limes museum on the Roman frontier; the rest is ordinary and not a reason to come.
gem:kasperske-hory: Šumava hill town at 733 m below Kašperk castle, with an old gold-ore works; a calm base, a short visit on its own.
gem:seligenstadt: Town with an old core and the Romanesque House; a pleasant afternoon, but little to hold a second day.
gem:oberhausen: Ruhr industrial city with a gasometer exhibition hall and a palace gallery; a day of industrial heritage, little beauty.
gem:kulmbach: Franconian town under the Plassenburg, with a tin-figure museum and the Petrikirche; a solid half day, quiet after that.
gem:monte-sant-angelo: Listed hilltop town at 800 m with the San Michele bell tower and the Tomba di Rotari; one rewarding day, little beyond it.
gem:ares-del-maestre: Listed stone village at 1,198 m with its castle and church above the Maestrat; a few hours, then little more to do.
gem:bruniquel: Listed among the Plus Beaux Villages de France, with the Château de Bruniquel above the river; a rewarding hour or two, small.
gem:hanau-am-main: Main city with Schloss Philippsruhe and the goldsmiths' house; little else in the centre to hold a visit.
gem:gorinchem: Fortified river town with the Dalempoort gate and harbour, Loevestein Castle 4 km off; a pleasant half day.
gem:capoliveri: Hill village on Elba with beaches and walks such as Monte Tambone around it; the named sights lie 5 to 9 km away.
gem:torrox: Axarquía white town above a beach strip, with Frigiliana 6 km away; a sunny base, little of its own to see.
gem:hellendoorn: Overijssel village near the Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park; most named sights lie 10 km away in Rijssen.
gem:aubusson: Listed tapestry town with the Maison du Tapissier and old houses; a couple of hours, with Felletin's churches nearby.
gem:rakvere: Order castle and the Trinity church give a good half day; a modest town otherwise.
gem:ferrol: Naval port city on a ria with the old Ferrol Vello quarter and castles at the harbour mouth; more working than showy.
gem:villalago: Abruzzo village on the borghi list beside Lake San Domenico, with a hermitage and the Sagittario gorge near; very small.
gem:sanlucar-de-barrameda: Castillo de Santiago, the Orleans-Borbón palace and Las Covachas in a coastal city; the beaches listed are far off and little else stands out.
gem:wisla: Beskid mountain resort with ski jumps and walks up Stożek and Czantoria; the town is a busy holiday strip.
gem:vaasa: Finnish coastal city with the Pohjanmaa museum, churches and a Tropiclandia water park; Korsholm Castle lies 6 km off.
gem:castellammare-di-stabia: Port city with the Roman Villa San Marco and Monte Faito above, 5 km from Pompeii; the city itself is uneven.
gem:jarvso: Hälsingland village with the Järvsö church, the Stenegård estate and the Järvzoo; pleasant for a night, few sights to linger over.
gem:horsens: Jutland fjord city with a former state prison museum, an industry museum and an art museum; plain streets, a day at most.
gem:jonkoping: Lakeside city on Vättern's beaches with a match museum and Sofia Church; pleasant shore, little to fill two days.
gem:collbato: Village at the foot of Montserrat with the Santa Cueva path above it; the monastery sights belong to the mountain.
gem:santarem: Old capital above the Tagus with Gothic churches such as Graça and São João de Alporão; quiet, and done in a day.
gem:medina-de-rioseco: Listed Tierra de Campos town with the churches of Santa María de Mediavilla and Santiago; a fine half day on the plain.
gem:slagelse: Zealand town with the Viking ring fortress of Trelleborg 6 km away and nearby dolmens; the town itself is plain.
gem:givet: Listed border town under the Fort de Charlemont, with Hierges castle and Freyr rocks near; worth a stop, little for a night.
gem:maikammer: Wine village under the Kalmit with Hambach Castle and Villa Ludwigshöhe a few kilometres away; a base more than a sight.
gem:san-fernando: Naval town on the Bay of Cádiz with the Real Teatro de las Cortes and Camposoto beach near; plain fabric beside Cádiz.
gem:chinchon: Listed historic town with its castle and old core near Madrid; a rewarding few hours, with little beyond.
gem:terespol: Border village facing Brest, whose fortress fills the sight list across the frontier; a crossing point, not a destination.
gem:wismar: Hanseatic brick churches such as St. Georgen and Heiligen-Geist, the Wasserkunst fountain and the Wassertor; a full day, quiet at night.
gem:saint-nazaire: Port city with the Escal'Atlantic liner museum and dolmens on its edge; the centre gives little reason to stay.
gem:cassino: The abbey of Monte Cassino above the town, with the Polish war cemetery and Roman Casinum; the rebuilt town itself has little charm.
gem:hilversum: Media city with the Sound and Vision institute and its town hall, heaths and woods around; green and pleasant, few reasons to stay.
gem:castelli: Tiny listed Abruzzo village under the Gran Sasso peaks, with an art-gallery museum and the San Gabriele sanctuary 6 km off.
gem:ejby: Small Zealand village whose listed sights are all in Køge, 7 km away; the UNESCO label does not fit what is here.
gem:chur: Alpine old town with the cathedral and bishop's court above it and the Rhaetian Museum; a good base, quickly seen itself.
gem:san-miniato: Hill town crowned by the Rocca di Federico II, with a sacred art museum and old oratories; a few hours, then quiet.
gem:lahti: Ski jumps, the Ski Museum and Sibelius Hall; a sports and concert town with a plain centre.
gem:potenza: Hilltop regional capital at 819 m with San Gerardo cathedral and two archaeology museums; little to keep a visitor for long.
gem:gie-en: University city with the Mathematikum and the Liebig Museum, Burg Gleiberg 4 km out; postwar streets and little beauty.
gem:montesarchio: Campanian town in the Borghi più belli list with its castle and the national archaeological museum of Sannio Caudino.
gem:pacentro: Mountain borgo at 690 m crowned by the Castello Caldora, 8 km from the Majella park; a lovely stop, little to hold a day.
gem:cala-millor: Long sandy bay with the Punta de n'Amer tower; a built-up resort strip, and the Drach caves are 9 km off.
gem:barga: Garfagnana hill borgo crowned by the San Frediano cathedral, with Pascoli's house museum; a fine half day, quiet beyond.
gem:castiglione-del-lago: Listed walled village with its castle on a headland of Lake Trasimeno; a rewarding half day, few sights beyond the lake.
gem:zabrze: Silesian mining city with the Guido coal mine museum underground; industrial heritage only, the townscape is plain.
gem:plauen: Vogtland city with the old Elster bridge, the Syratal viaduct and the Vogtland Museum; worthy sights in an uneven centre.
gem:kuopio: Finnish lakeside city with the Puijo tower, a market square and a cathedral; good outdoors, a thin historic core.
gem:noirmoutier-en-l-ile: Island town on Noirmoutier with its castle and the Müllembourg salt-marsh reserve; relaxed holiday base, few sights of note.
gem:castellabate: Listed Cilento village above a marine park and rocky coast; the sea and views carry it, with few sights inside the village.
gem:appelscha: Village by a national park, with lakes and sand drifts near; a family holiday base, plain in itself.
gem:sundsvall: Coastal city on the Gulf of Bothnia with lake beaches close by; the listed sights are mostly village churches outside town.
gem:laon: Cathedral at the heart of an old town with a bishop's palace and Hôtel-Dieu; strong, but small enough for a day.
gem:sorano: Listed tufa village with the Parco archeologico del Tufo, Pitigliano 7 km and Lake Bolsena within 20 km; a fine half day, quiet beyond.
gem:chalkida: Port city on the Euripus strait with its bridge, ancient Aulis 3 km away; a lively waterfront, but little to hold a visitor.
gem:tudela: Navarre town with a cathedral, a palace museum and a listed historic quarter; compact, with a modest evening life.
gem:moss: Fjord-side town where the 1814 Convention of Moss was signed; one historic house, otherwise an ordinary industrial town.
gem:orleans: Loire city of Joan of Arc with its Gothic cathedral and the Musée des Beaux-Arts; handsome centre, rarely more than a day.
gem:valjevo: Regional city with the Nenadović tower, Ćelije monastery and Petnica cave nearby; a short stop, few sights in town.
gem:sandefjord: Former whaling town with a whaling museum and the Gokstad Viking mound; a few hours of interest, otherwise ordinary.
gem:iserlohn: Sauerland city with the Dechen stalactite cave four kilometres away and several museums; mixed in feel, and a day at most.
gem:kalisz: Old Polish city with a cathedral, town hall and regional museum; a tidy centre that is done in a few hours.
gem:colares: Village in the Sintra-Cascais natural park, 4 to 5 km from the Sintra palaces and Cabo da Roca; valued as a base.
gem:konigswinter: Rhine town below the Drachenfels ruin and Schloss Drachenburg in the Siebengebirge; a day trip from Bonn more than a stay.
gem:cambrils: Fishing-port resort with town beaches and the Torre del Port, PortAventura 8 km off; a beach base, little to see itself.
gem:ballenstedt: Harz-edge town by the Teufelsmauer rocks, with Burg Falkenstein 5 km off; the town itself fills a short visit.
gem:montalcino: Hill town with its fortress, a base for the Val d'Orcia and the abbey of Sant'Antimo nearby; the town itself is quickly seen.
gem:conil-de-la-frontera: White old town with the Guzmán tower and La Chanca, above long Costa de la Luz beaches; lively but busy in summer.
gem:freising: Bavarian town with a cathedral, the Weihenstephan brewery and old buildings; a calm day from Munich, little for a night.
gem:poros: Island town on Poros with a monastery, the Burtzi fortress and Askeli beach 1.5 km away; the Kalaureia site lies 3 km off.
gem:citta-di-castello: Walled Umbrian town with the Pinacoteca, the cathedral and its round bell tower; a half day, little beyond.
gem:apricale: Listed hill village around its Castello della Lucertola, Dolceacqua castle 4 km away; a lovely half day, small for more.
gem:lapithos: Coastal village with a monastery and a hillside above the sea; the card shows little to hold a visit.
gem:loudun: Listed small town with its square tower, town hall and Sainte-Croix church; a pleasant hour or two, little more.
gem:hamm: Railway junction city in the Ruhr fringe with a town hall and the Maximilianpark; plain and postwar, no reason to visit.
gem:canillo: Andorran mountain village at 1,561 metres with two old churches and peaks near; a walking and snow base, with little else.
gem:celle: Half-timbered old town around Schloss Celle and its baroque theatre; lovely streets, but flat surroundings and a day is enough.
gem:castello-del-matese: Hill village at the foot of the Matese park with a small civic museum; the Roman remains of Alife are 6 km away.
gem:kaposvar: County town with a cathedral, the Csiky theatre and Lake Deseda close by; little that holds a visitor for long.
gem:sedan: The vast Château de Sedan fortress dominates the town; worth a half day for it, the rest of town is plain.
gem:villafames: Historic hill village with a castle and a contemporary art museum; a rewarding half day, little for a longer stay.
gem:atienza: Hill village of 430 people under a ruined castle, with a protected historic core and several old churches; remote.
gem:fussen: Old Allgäu town at 800 m with St. Mang's Abbey, 4 km from Neuschwanstein and the Alpsee; a strong base, crowded in season.
gem:anzio: Seaside town known for the 1944 landings, with Allied war cemeteries 3 km away; a sober visit, little else to hold you.
gem:ponte-di-legno: Alpine resort below the Adamello and the Tonale pass, a good walking and ski base; the village has few sights.
gem:varazze: Ligurian beach town with the Beigua hills behind and the Eremo del Deserto nearby; a seaside stay, few sights of its own.
gem:palmanova: Listed star-shaped Venetian fortress town with its Redentore church and aqueduct; striking in plan, but done in a couple of hours.
gem:kloetinge: Small village beside Goes with a hunting lodge and windmills, the Veerse Meer 8 km away; little to hold a visit.
gem:eslov: Skåne railway town with a town church; the manors listed lie in the countryside, with no reason to stop.
gem:monflanquin: Lot-et-Garonne village listed among the Plus Beaux Villages de France, with the Maison du Prince Noir; an hour's stroll, little more.
gem:saint-quentin: The Basilique Saint-Quentin and an ornate town hall; the rest of the city gives little reason to stay.
gem:petrovac-na-moru: Coastal village with several beaches within reach and monasteries inland; mostly a seaside stay, light on sights.
gem:aalsmeerderbrug: Polder hamlet by the Stommeer mill with lakes and Amsterdam forts nearby; nothing that makes it a destination.
gem:casole-d-elsa: Tuscan hill village awarded the Touring Club's Orange Flag, with a collegiate church and civic museum; the card names little else.
gem:aguilas: Coastal town under its castle of San Juan, with coves and beaches along the shore; a resort town more than a place with depth.
gem:medina-del-campo: The brick Castle of La Mota and the palace where Isabel the Catholic made her will, in a listed Castilian town; half a day.
gem:airolo: Alpine village at 1,162 m at the foot of the Gotthard Pass, with forts and the Gotthard Tunnel; a transit point more than a stay.
gem:hunnerberg: A residential district of Nijmegen near the Waalbrug; its sights are the city's, not a place to travel to on its own.
gem:taramundi: Asturian hill village near the Teixois mill complex and the Mazonovo mills museum; rural and quiet, a few hours of sights.
gem:vlissingen: Zeeland seaside town with beaches and a harbour past; the main sights are in Middelburg seven kilometres away.
gem:njegusi: Highland village at 900 m between Lovćen National Park and the Bay of Kotor; a stop on the road rather than a stay.
gem:loos-en-gohelle: Mining-basin village with UNESCO spoil tips and the Vimy and Lorette memorials within 9 km; little to hold you in the village itself.
gem:remscheid: Bergisches Land city whose main sight is the Müngsten Bridge 4 km away; Burg Castle lies 5 km off, the centre is plain.
gem:bad-lauterberg-im-harz: Harz spa town with forest walks and the Unicorn Cave near; a quiet resort with little of its own.
gem:boras: Textile city with the Textile Museum and Caroli church; an ordinary Swedish centre that is quickly done.
gem:manciano: Listed Maremma hill village 8 km from the Terme di Saturnia, with the Poggio Buco necropolis near; a good base, small in itself.
gem:le-poet-laval: Listed among France's most beautiful villages, a perched village with the castle of the counts of Poitiers and an old Protestant temple; small.
gem:bar-le-duc: Listed Renaissance upper town with the cadaver tomb of René of Chalon; handsome but quiet, done in half a day.
gem:litochoro: Foot-of-Olympus town in the national park, with the ancient site of Dion 8 km off; a base for walkers, modest itself.
gem:palamos: Costa Brava town with a cloister and a lighthouse near, and cove beaches like Cala Pola; light on sights.
gem:rovigo: Palazzi and a cathedral in a flat Veneto city centre; little here to hold a visitor beyond a few hours.
gem:follonica: Long-beach resort on the Maremma gulf with an iron-works museum; Cala Violina and the old villages are elsewhere.
gem:jawor: Silesian town known for its UNESCO-listed Peace Church, a rare timber church; a good short stop, little else to hold a day.
gem:oosterhout: Brabant town whose listed sights are mostly in Breda, 8 to 9 km away; a plain centre with no draw of its own.
gem:saint-raphael: Riviera resort with the Rastel d'Agay coast and Fréjus Cathedral 3 km away; a beach base with little old character.
gem:les-eyzies-de-tayac-sireuil: Prehistory village with the Cro-Magnon shelter, Font-de-Gaume and Combarelles caves and the national museum; deep for its kind, small otherwise.
gem:toras: Tiny upland village whose named sights, the aqueduct and Calatrava castle, belong to neighbouring Bejís; little of its own.
gem:hechingen: Swabian town below Burg Hohenzollern, 3 km away, with a museum and walks on the Raichberg; the town centre is ordinary.
gem:pirot-centralni-trg: Town centre with Pirot Fortress and the Nativity church, mountains within 25 km; a short stop, little to hold a night.
gem:cesena: Romagna city with the Biblioteca Malatestiana, the Rocca Malatestiana and its cathedral; one notable library, a few hours.
gem:bauge-en-anjou: Listed Anjou town with its château, Benedictine convent and old town houses; pleasant for an hour or two, quiet beyond.
gem:bukkszentkereszt: Bükk hill village at 570 m, caves and Miskolc's zoo and cave bath 5 to 8 km off; a walking base, little in it.
gem:jelgava: Latvian city with the baroque Jelgava Palace and an Orthodox cathedral; a palace visit, otherwise a plain postwar town.
gem:castroreale: Listed Sicilian hill village with the Frederick II tower and a civic museum, the coast 14 km off; a couple of hours.
gem:cazalla-de-la-sierra: Listed hill town at 622 m with its old charterhouse and parish church; a few hours, with little else named on the card.
gem:bad-muskau: UNESCO-listed Muskau Park with the English Bridge, the Kromlau rhododendron park 5 km off; the park is the reason, the town adds little.
gem:naousa: Paros fishing village with a castle ruin; the big church and the beaches lie further off, so it suits an easy base.
gem:montargis: Listed town with the Madeleine church and the Buges lock nearby; a pleasant stroll, few sights to fill a day.
gem:sassello: Ligurian inland village by the Deiva forest and the Beigua park 8 km off; good for walks, little to see in the village.
gem:noordwijk-binnen: Inland old village of a dune resort, with Keukenhof and Leiden's museums under 10 km; the draws are elsewhere, fine as a base.
gem:belves: Listed Périgord village with its castle, church and old market hall; a couple of hours, then the valley around.
gem:huelva: Port city with the Riotinto ore pier, the Merced cathedral and La Rábida monastery near; mostly modern and short on beauty.
gem:buer: A district of Gelsenkirchen with the Propsteikirche and stadium sites; Ruhr suburb streets, not a place to travel to.
gem:luz-saint-sauveur: Pyrenean village with a Templar church and baths, Pic du Midi 14 km away; a mountain base more than a sight.
gem:giulianova: Adriatic town with San Flaviano, the Rocca tower and small museums near its beach; pleasant, not a destination.
gem:aarau: Neat Swiss cantonal town with Lake Hallwil 18 km away; its named sights are mostly nearby villages, an hour or two in town.
gem:starigrad: Coastal village at the gate of Paklenica National Park, the Anića kuk cliffs 4 km off; a climbing and hiking base, little in the village.
gem:ravensburg: Swabian town of medieval towers below the Veitsburg, with the Ravensburger museum; a good day, Lake Constance 20 km off.
gem:pettorano-sul-gizio: Abruzzo hill village of 500 people at the edge of Maiella national park; a quiet base with few sights of its own.
gem:holte: Copenhagen suburb with palaces, lakes and Dyrehaven park nearby; a green, pleasant edge of the city, not a destination.
gem:la-chaux-de-fonds: Jura watchmaking town with the International Museum of Horology and early Le Corbusier villas; a grid of plain streets, a day at most.
gem:constantina: Listed white town under a castle in a biosphere reserve of the Sierra Norte; few named sights for more than half a day.
gem:lukov: Moravian village with Lukov Castle and Lešná Castle nearby; quiet, and the other listed sights lie 8 to 9 km away.
gem:diepenheim: Small Dutch village among country estates and moated houses; peaceful, with little to see once you have walked it.
gem:bibione: Purpose-built beach resort by the Tagliamento mouth and the Caorle lagoon; sand and pinewoods, but little character or sights.
gem:mala-skala: Village below Frýdštejn Castle, with Rotštejn, Hrubý Rohozec and Sychrov within 8 km; a good walking base, small itself.
gem:cuxhaven: North Sea resort with the Kugelbake beacon, Schloss Ritzebüttel and ships passing on the Elbe; a day is plenty.
gem:neptun: Black Sea resort with beaches such as Olimp and Mangalia's Callatis museum near; a summer beach stop, little character of its own.
gem:algeciras: Busy ferry port with the Marinid walls and Parque María Cristina, beaches toward Tarifa; a crossing point, not a place to linger.
gem:fazana: Istrian fishing village facing the Brijuni Islands National Park 4 km off, with Pula's arena 7 km away; small, more base than sight.
gem:louveciennes: Leafy commune 6 km from the Palace of Versailles and near Saint-Germain-en-Laye; a base for those sights, little to see itself.
gem:leer: East Frisian town with a moated manor house and churches; quiet and compact, with few sights.
gem:halmstad: West-coast city with its castle and Tylösand beach 8 km away; a summer beach base more than a place to explore.
gem:la-ciotat: Shipyard town at the foot of Cap Canaille, with the calanques of Port-Pin and En-Vau within 9 km; the town itself is ordinary.
gem:avoise: Small Sarthe Petite Cité de Caractère; the manors listed lie 4 to 7 km away, nothing in the village to travel for.
gem:rastatt: Baroque Residenz palace and the Favorite palace nearby give the town its weight; otherwise a regional centre.
gem:dortmund: Big Ruhr city with the U-Tower, the stadium and art museums; some energy, but few sights to hold more than a day.
gem:semmering: Mountain resort at 980 m on the UNESCO-listed Semmering railway, with Rax and Schneeberg near; the village itself is small and scattered.
gem:riedenburg: Valley village under its castle ruins, with Schloss Prunn 4 km away on its crag; a good base for castles, little in the village itself.
gem:laval: Old quarter with the cathedral, the Porte Beucheresse and the viaduct; a pleasant stop, thin for a second day.
gem:greetsiel: East Frisian harbour village with its twin windmills, church and the Pilsum lighthouse 3 km away; pretty but small and busy in season.
gem:ciudad-rodrigo: Listed walled town with the Santa María cathedral, Enrique II castle and noble palaces; a rewarding half day, remote and quiet.
gem:altamura: Apulian city with its Romanesque cathedral and the Lamalunga cave 6 km out; a good stop, though the centre is small.
gem:paralimni: Inland Cyprus town 6 km from Nissi beach and near Fig Tree Bay; the beaches draw, the town itself offers little.
gem:koln: Cologne Cathedral, Romanesque churches such as St. Gereon and fine museums by the Rhine; lively, but much of the fabric is plain postwar rebuilding.
gem:garderen: Veluwe village by the Hunneschans earthwork, 4 km away; the lakes lie 16 to 19 km off and the village itself is small.
gem:durres: Albanian port city with a Roman amphitheatre, mosques and a beach 3 km away; an uneven, busy urban fabric around them.
gem:emden: East Frisian port with the Kunsthalle and the regional museum; a museum day, the rebuilt town has little charm.
gem:manresa: Santa Maria church, the Pont Vell and Saint Ignatius's cave, with Montserrat 14 km off; an ordinary city around them.
gem:komarno: Danube border town with fortress bastions and Roman Brigetio across the river; interesting for a half day, plain otherwise.
gem:pori: Finnish port city with its central church and theatre, and Yyteri beach 17 km away; plain streets and little to hold you.
gem:yevre-la-ville: Small Loiret village with a listed-village label, though the castle named is at Yèvre-le-Châtel; quiet, with little to see.
gem:fiumefreddo-bruzio: Listed Calabrian hill village of old churches and palazzi above the Tyrrhenian; small, with few sights beyond a short walk.
gem:trollhattan: Trollhättan Falls and the canal locks give a good few hours; the town around them is plain.
gem:altotting: Bavarian pilgrimage town around the Gnadenkapelle on Kapellplatz, with a basilica and collegiate church; focused on one square.
gem:pola-de-somiedo: Gateway village to the Somiedo natural park and biosphere reserve in the Cantabrian peaks; walking country with little in the village.
gem:oropesa-del-mar: Beach resort with a small castle and watchtowers along the shore; a summer stay on the sand, not a place to explore.
gem:miltenberg: Half-timbered Main town below the Mildenburg, with the old inn Zum Riesen; a lovely street, done in half a day.
gem:norcia: Umbrian town at the foot of the Sibillini mountains, home of the Basilica of Saint Benedict; the core is small and quiet.
gem:skara: Old Swedish bishop's town around Skara Cathedral; an hour for the cathedral, little else to keep you.
gem:turenne: Listed among France's most beautiful villages, a castle hill village near the Lac du Causse; the listed churches are mostly in nearby hamlets.
gem:soultzeren: Vosges valley village below the Hohneck with castles and Pairis Abbey 6 to 9 km away; little of its own.
gem:labastide-murat: Quiet village in a UNESCO Geopark; its sights are churches and a château 4 to 7 km away, with little in the village.
gem:donaueschingen: Baar town with the town church and a Roman fort site near, on the edge of the Black Forest; tidy but short on sights.
gem:quercianella: Small Tuscan coastal village with the Calafuria nature reserve, a coastal tower 3 km away and Montenero sanctuary 4 km off.
gem:casale-monferrato: Po-side town with San Domenico church and a fine Jewish museum in its synagogue; a few good hours, little more.
gem:tatranska-lomnica: High Tatras resort at 845 m under Lomnický štít, with Skalnaté pleso and the Belianska cave near; a mountain base, the village itself is plain.
gem:worlitz: UNESCO-listed Wörlitz landscape park with its palace and synagogue, a full day of garden walks; the village is only its gateway.
gem:oberems: Taunus hamlet with the Hattstein castle ruin 3 km away and Großer Feldberg 4 km; little in the village itself.
gem:sansepolcro: Walled Tuscan town with its Museo Civico and Piazza Santa Chiara, Anghiari seven kilometres away; a rewarding half day, quiet evenings.
gem:altenburg: Thuringian town with a residence palace, the Lindenau art museum and a theatre; handsome core, but quiet and a day at most.
gem:gressoney-saint-jean: Alpine village at 1,385 metres with a royal castle and a botanical garden below high peaks; small, built for walkers and skiers.
gem:morlaix: A great railway viaduct strides over the old town, with walls and old churches below; a good half day, quiet in the evening.
gem:calais: Rodin's Burghers of Calais before the town hall, a lighthouse and a war museum; a ferry port more than a place to stay.
gem:riihimaki: Finnish rail-junction town with the Finnish Glass Museum; one museum, otherwise little to draw a visit.
gem:paralia: Beach resort on a long sandy shore with a marina; built for summer holidays, with little character or sights of its own.
gem:luxeuil-les-bains: Spa town with an old abbey, basilica and Renaissance mansions; quiet, and done well inside a day.
gem:calatafimi: Hill town 4 km from the Doric temple and Greek theatre of Segesta; a base for that site, little in town.
gem:bolsward: Old Frisian town among windmills, with the Sneekermeer lakes 15 km off; little to fill more than a few hours.
gem:pforzheim: The Reuchlinhaus, the Kollmar and Jourdan House and the Enz valley nearby; a plain centre with little to hold you.
gem:malborghetto: Val Canale hamlet under the Jôf di Montasio and Monte Lussari; a quiet base for Julian Alps walks, little in the village.
gem:auray: Breton river town and Ville d'art et d'histoire, with megaliths and tumuli 4 to 9 km away; a pleasant base, small.
gem:fiumaretta-di-ameglia: Beach hamlet at the mouth of the Magra near Montemarcello and the Luni ruins; a summer base, the old borgo is up the hill.
gem:gulpen: Village in the rolling South Limburg hills, with castles and the American war cemetery close by; a pleasant base, little in itself.
gem:selestat: Alsace town with the Humanist Library and the churches of Sainte-Foy and Saint-Georges; a good stop, quieter than its neighbours.
gem:chalon-sur-saone: The Niépce photography museum and the cathedral quarter reward a few hours; a plain Saône town beyond that.
gem:bar-sur-seine: Small Champagne-region town of character with a half-timbered house, a castle and Lac d'Orient 18 km away; quiet.
gem:wolfertschwenden: Allgäu farming village with the old Ittelsburg refuge and chapel; a few earthworks, nothing that draws a trip.
gem:arad: The Fortress of Arad and the Administrative Palace, with a floodplain park 5 km off; a pleasant stop, little to fill a second day.
gem:jindrichuv-hradec: Bohemian town built around a large castle, with churches and a plague column; a quiet day, few other draws.
gem:ligatne: Old paper-mill village with sandstone cliffs, on the edge of Gauja National Park; a half day, then little else.
gem:tavarnelle-val-di-pesa: Listed Tuscan village in Chianti country; its churches and museum of sacred art are modest, and the nearest sights sit six to ten kilometres off.
gem:ossuccio: Lake Como shore village with the UNESCO Sacro Monte and Villa del Balbianello; small, and the lake road brings heavy traffic.
gem:kassiopi: North Corfu harbour village with a fortress and Kalamionas beach; Mount Pantokrator lies 6 km off, and the village is small.
gem:ruzova: Village base in Bohemian Switzerland, 5 km from the Pravčická brána rock arch and near the Kamnitz gorge; little in the village itself.
gem:amerongen: Dutch village with Kasteel Amerongen and the Andrieskerk; Huis Doorn lies 9 km away, and there is little else.
gem:alarcon: Castle village on its rock above the Júcar near the Alarcón reservoir; tiny, a rewarding half day at most.
gem:ravda: Resort village between Sunny Beach and old Nesebar's churches 5 km off; a beach stay, little character of its own.
gem:salins-les-bains: UNESCO-listed salt works in a small town; distinctive, though compact and quiet beyond the saltworks.
gem:hel: Village at the tip of the Hel peninsula with a lighthouse, a seal sanctuary and beaches; busy in summer, few other sights.
gem:lelystad: Polder new town near the Bataviawerf and the Aviodrome; a planned centre with little to see in town.
gem:middelkerke: Belgian beach resort of apartment blocks; the galleries, casino and museums listed are all in Ostend.
gem:zdar: Rural base on the edge of the Bohemian Paradise, Kost and Valdštejn castles within 7 km; the village itself has little.
gem:vlasim: Small Czech town with Vlašim castle and its park, Blaník hill 7 km away; a pleasant stop, little to hold a day.
gem:auxerre: Riverside Burgundy town with a Gothic cathedral and Saint-Germain abbey above the Yonne; a good stop, quiet in the evening.
gem:kristianstad: Scanian town in a UNESCO biosphere reserve, with Stora kronohuset and churches around; a pleasant stop, little to hold you.
gem:torre-del-mar: Spanish beach resort town on the Costa del Sol; the real old centre is in Vélez-Málaga, 5 km away.
gem:herne: Ruhr city with Schloss Strünkede and an archaeology museum, the mining museum in Bochum nearby; no centre that draws visitors.
gem:eichstatt: Baroque bishops' town with a cathedral, the Residenz and Willibaldsburg castle in the Altmühltal park; quiet, a day is enough.
gem:garrucha: Small fishing port and beach town in Almería with a castle and a few promenades; little to see.
gem:zwaagdijk-west: Polder village with a windmill, its listed sights all in Hoorn 3 to 4 km away; nothing to come for in itself.
gem:bad-langensalza: Thuringian spa town around the Marktkirche St. Stephani; a tidy old centre, few sights to fill a day.
gem:oulmes: Quiet edge-of-marsh village near the Marais Poitevin and Maillezais abbey; its own core is small and plain.
gem:vresina: Village on the edge of Ostrava with churches and a mine site 3 to 9 km away; the card names nothing of its own.
gem:zafra: Extremaduran town with a protected historic core and the Ducal Palace of Feria; compact, with a short list of sights.
gem:konstantinovy-lazne: Tiny Czech spa village; the castles on the card lie 4 to 9 km away and the card says little else.
gem:guilherand-granges: Residential town whose listed sights, the cathedral and Maison des Têtes, belong to Valence across the river; little of its own.
gem:schmallenberg: Sauerland town with a monastery at Grafschaft and viewing tower 3 km away; green hills, but little in the town.
gem:dannewerk: Village by the Viking Danevirke and Haithabu, a UNESCO site; Schleswig's Gottorf Castle and cathedral lie 4 to 5 km off.
gem:schonau-am-konigssee: Alpine village on the Königssee under the Watzmann, St Bartholomew's and the Eagle's Nest close by; superb walking, very busy in season.
gem:helmond: Brabant city with a moated castle and cube houses; two sights in an ordinary town, an hour or two.
gem:vilamoura: Algarve resort village by Falésia and other beaches; good for sun, but little local life or heritage of its own.
gem:galati: Industrial city with a fortified Precista church and a cathedral; few sights and little old fabric to hold a visit.
gem:esbjerg: North Sea port city with the Men at Sea statues, a fisheries museum and an art museum; a working port, few reasons to stay.
gem:chios: Island port with its castle, Ottoman fountain and mosque, Nea Moni 7 km off; a base for the island more than a sight.
gem:calella: Catalan resort town on the Maresme coast with a lighthouse and a market; beaches are the draw, little else.
gem:san-enrique-de-guadiaro: Small coastal village by the Guadiaro with watchtowers and the Roman site of Barbesula; a resort hinterland with little to draw you.
gem:miskolc: Industrial city with the cave bath at Miskolctapolca and a Greek Catholic cathedral; the centre itself holds little.
gem:arenas-de-san-pedro: Gredos town with its castle, the Palacio de la Mosquera and a royal chapel; a short visit below the high sierra.
gem:theoule-sur-mer: Small resort under the Pic de l'Ours on the Esterel coast, Cannes 8 km away; a good beach base with no sight of its own.
gem:crest: Drôme town dominated by the medieval Tour de Crest keep above the river; worth an hour or two, little more.
gem:sare: Listed Basque village around the Saint-Martin church, the Sare caves 5 km off; lovely for a half day, quiet after.
gem:leba: Baltic resort village with a long beach and a rocket-launch museum 3 km away; summer-led, thin on historic sights.
gem:schwelm: Small Ruhr-edge town whose listed sights, such as the Wuppertal Schwebebahn, lie 7 to 11 km away; no reason to stop.
gem:narbonne: The cathedral, Archbishops' Palace and two museums give a full day, lagoons 10 km away; the wider town is ordinary.
gem:joigny: Yonne riverside town with three old churches on its slope; a pleasant stop of an hour or two, not a destination.
gem:hamar: Town with the cathedral ruins at Domkirkeodden and the Hamardomen hall; a few hours covers it.
gem:domme: Dordogne bastide village in the Plus Beaux Villages list, with a rock-cut chapel at Caudon; Castelnaud lies 5 km away.
gem:santa-uxia-de-ribeira: Fishing town 3 km from the Corrubedo dunes park, with the Axeitos dolmen near; the town itself is plain.
gem:markov-grad: Rocky fortress of Markovi Kuli with the Treskavec monastery 5 km away; worth a climb, but the town below holds little.
gem:obernai: Listed Alsace town, base for Mont Sainte-Odile convent and Landsberg castle six kilometres away; the card names few sights of its own.
gem:bad-reichenhall: Alpine town with the Predigtstuhl cable car and Königssee within 25 km; a calm base, short on sights of its own.
gem:de-koog: Texel's main beach village at the edge of the dune national park, with a maritime museum; busy in season, plain streets.
gem:simrishamn: Coastal Skåne town with a harbour church and a chapel, and beaches such as Stenshuvud near; few sights of its own.
gem:dingli: Maltese village on a high plateau near Mdina, with the megalithic temples 6 to 7 km off; its own list of sights is short.
gem:barth: Small Baltic lagoon town with the Marienkirche, a town gate and the Bibelzentrum; the beaches are twenty kilometres off.
gem:dormans: Marne valley village within a UNESCO listing, Troissy castle 5 km away; a quiet stop among vineyards, few sights of note.
gem:oisterwijk: Brabant town among heath fens such as the Belversven, the Loonse en Drunense Duinen eight kilometres off; for walkers, few sights.
gem:uddevalla: West Swedish port town with its church and Gustafsberg bathing resort 3 km out; a plain centre with little to hold a visitor.
gem:balatonlelle: Lake Balaton beach village with a lookout tower and Badacsony across the water; one resort among many on this shore.
gem:canet-d-en-berenguer: Beach village near Sagunto, whose castle and old town lie 5 to 6 km away; a holiday strip with nothing of its own to see.
gem:asenovgrad: Base 3 km from Asen's Fortress and 8 km from Bachkovo Monastery; the town itself is plain.
gem:dubravice: Hamlet close to Krka National Park, with Skradinski Buk and Roški slap 6 km off; a base for the falls, nothing in the village.
gem:eskilstuna: Industrial city with the old Rademacher forges and runestones around; a working town, not one to travel for.
gem:haigerloch: Swabian town in the Eyach valley with its Schlosskirche, Roman tower and Jewish cemetery; a short stop, little more.
gem:castrogeriz: Listed Camino village below its castle with Nuestra Señora del Manzano and the San Antón ruins nearby; a strong pilgrim stop, little more.
gem:radom: Large Polish city with its cathedral and several old churches; little beyond them to bring a visitor.
gem:pernes-les-fontaines: Listed Comtat town of fountains and old lanes, Carpentras 6 km away; pretty for a couple of hours, little to hold a day.
gem:buitrago-del-lozoya: Walled Madrid-sierra town with a castle, a historic quarter and the Picasso museum of his barber; on a reservoir, small and quiet.
gem:pec-pod-snezkou: Mountain resort below Sněžka, 5 km off, in the Krkonoše national park; a base for walks, with little village life of its own.
gem:kastanies: Border village whose listed sights, the Selimiye Mosque among them, all lie in Edirne across the frontier; nothing of its own to hold a visit.
gem:alise-sainte-reine: Hill of Alesia with its excavations, Gallo-Roman theatre and Vercingetorix statue, Flavigny and Bussy-Rabutin 4 km off; small village otherwise.
gem:schwabisch-gmund: Holy Cross Minster and a museum in the old Dominican priory, with the Hohenstaufen hills nearby; a modest centre for a day.
gem:braine: Small Aisne village whose named sights are farms and churches in nearby villages; the UNESCO label on the card does not fit, little here.
gem:cherbourg: Port town with the Cité de la Mer and the submarine Le Redoutable; the rest of the town gives little reason to stay.
gem:timmendorfer-strand: Baltic beach resort with a string of beaches and Travemünde 8 km away; a summer seaside stay, little to see in town.
gem:badenweiler: Hillside spa village under the Blauen with castle ruins and Belchen close by; a calm stay, but little of its own to see.
gem:heerlen: Former mining city with castles such as Hoensbroek a few kilometres out; the centre itself gives little reason to stay.
gem:compiegne: The imperial château and its theatre anchor the visit, with an abbey and churches; the rest of the town is modest.
gem:winschoten: Groningen market town with windmills, a pumping station museum and the Oldambtmeer lake 4 km out; little to make a trip of.
gem:thale: Harz town below the Hexentanzplatz and Teufelsmauer rock wall, 3 km away; Quedlinburg lies 8 km off, the town itself is plain.
gem:bechyne: Small spa town with Bechyně Castle, a synagogue and the Bechyně Bridge; worth a half day, with little to keep you overnight.
gem:auch: Gascon town with a cathedral basilica, a Jacobin convent and the Intendance; quiet, a stop rather than a stay.
gem:murzasichle: Highland village at 943 m beside Zakopane, a quieter base for Kasprowy Wierch and the Tatras; little to see in the village itself.
gem:schweinfurt: Industrial city on the Main known for the Museum Georg Schäfer art collection; a plain centre, worth an hour for the museum.
gem:archidona: Listed Andalusian hill town with convents and a hilltop shrine of the Virgen de Gracia; a pleasant half day, little more.
gem:san-giljan: Built-up bay of bars and hotels a few kilometres from Valletta's sights; lively at night, short on its own beauty.
gem:sainte-mere-eglise: D-Day village with its church and a history museum, Utah Beach 10 km off; a few hours of war history, little else.
gem:saint-fargeau: Small Burgundy-edge town built around its large château, with a lake nearby; the castle carries it, the rest is quiet.
gem:siegen: Hilly city with the Unteres Schloss and Martinikirche; a few hours at most, with little else to hold you.
gem:blankenburg: Harz foothill town with a small palace, sandstone caves 3 km away and rock outcrops; quiet and modest in scale.
gem:oberwesel: Rhine gorge village with the Loreley 4 km off and Burg Katz nearby; one stop among many alike on this river.
gem:halberstadt: Gothic cathedral and the Gleimhaus museum anchor a Harz-edge town; much of the rest is plain rebuilt fabric.
gem:puebla-de-sanabria: Listed hilltop town under its counts' castle, with Sanabria Lake 10 km away; small and quiet.
gem:kreuzau: Rur valley village near Düren with a few chapels; Burg Nideggen and the museums lie in other towns.
gem:veroia: Macedonian town of Byzantine churches, Ottoman mosques, a twin bath house and archaeology museum; a full half day, a plain town around.
gem:soesterberg: Village on the Utrecht heath near the Pyramid of Austerlitz; its other named sights are 8 km away, so little to stop for.
gem:bendorf: Rhine town with Burg Sayn; the big sights listed belong to Koblenz, 7 to 8 km away, so it works only as a cheap base.
gem:bad-salzuflen: Spa town whose named sights are mostly in Herford 6 to 7 km away; a quiet place to stay, little to see itself.
gem:alcoceber: Beach resort with watchtowers along the coast and the Xivert castle 7 km inland; sandy coves, but a modern holiday strip.
gem:de-reit: Suburban district on the edge of Tilburg with a small animal park; the sights listed are Tilburg's, not a destination.
gem:didymoteicho: Thracian border town with the Çelebi Sultan Mehmed Mosque and a castle; two sights, an hour or two, far from anywhere.
gem:ruinen: Village by a national park with the Dwingeloo radio telescope 6 km away; good for cycling and walks, little to see in the village.
gem:jerez-de-los-caballeros: Historic town with a castle, churches and a dolmen 5 km out; a quiet heritage stop that few days could fill.
gem:begunje-na-gorenjskem: Quiet village under the Stol ridge, ten kilometres from Lake Bled; a calm base, but the sights on the card belong to Bled.
gem:rogoznica: Croatian harbour village with a marina and coves 7 km away; the card names no sight worth a detour.
gem:hulst: Walled fortress town with the Sint-Willibrordus basilica, the Dubbele Poort and a town windmill; a pleasant half day, little beyond.
gem:moraira: Small resort with a coastal castle and the Cap d'Or tower, the Penyal d'Ifac 8 km off; a beach stay, little else.
gem:nideggen: Eifel town crowned by Burg Nideggen above the Rur valley; once the castle is seen, little holds you.
gem:kongsberg: Mining town with the Norwegian Mining Museum, a large church and a ski museum; a few hours, little to fill a second day.
gem:johvi: Estonian town with a church and the Baltic Klint on its list; Kukruse manor lies 5 km away, and the card is thin.
gem:loenen: Veluwe village by the Loenermark heath and a paper mill museum; its listed sights are in nearby villages.
gem:hoenderloo: Village at the edge of the Veluwe national park, close to the Kröller-Müller sculpture garden; little to see in the village itself.
gem:norrtalje: Roslagen town with an industry museum and an old steamship; the churches listed lie in country parishes around it.
gem:torre-de-la-horadada: Beach village with its old watchtower and coves nearby; one resort among many along this coast.
gem:coulon: Village on the edge of the Marais Poitevin regional park, listed for character; the waterways are the draw, sights of its own are few.
gem:almagro: Listed historic town with its Corral de Comedias theatre and an old convent; a rewarding half day on the plain, little around it.
gem:vouliagmeni: Seaside suburb of Athens with a swimming lake and the Temple of Apollo Zoster; polished, but little old character.
gem:minden: City with its cathedral, the old government building and the Minden canal aqueduct; a few hours, then little more.
gem:calarasi: The card names only a county library and one old house; no sight that would make it worth a detour.
gem:vimoutiers: Small Normandy town with a Tiger tank memorial and manors in the surrounding countryside; little to hold a visit.
gem:ile-aux-moines: Island in the Gulf of Morbihan with beaches and megaliths close by; small, with a short list of things to do.
gem:mataro: Coastal city with Gaudí's Nau and modernist houses such as Casa Coll i Regàs; a few hours, in a largely workaday town.
gem:lassay-les-chateaux: Listed small town with its castle and the Château du Bois Thibault ruin; an hour or two, then little else.
gem:herning: HEART art museum and the Carl-Henning Pedersen museum are worth an hour; otherwise a plain inland trade town.
gem:janov-nad-nisou: Jizera hill village near two reservoirs; the castle, town hall and museums listed are all in Liberec, 8 km away.
gem:mavrovi-anovi: Mountain village at 1,267 m in Mavrovo National Park, with a submerged church of St. Nicholas 5 km away; small and seasonal.
gem:avallon: Burgundy town on its ramparts with the Saint-Lazare collegiate church; a fine half day, quiet after that.
gem:ansouis: Listed Luberon village crowned by its own château, with Lourmarin castle nine kilometres off; small and quiet.
gem:eenrum: Groningen village with the Hollands Welvaart mill and borgs such as Allersmaborg nearby; quiet, with little to fill a visit.
gem:saint-nectaire: Village of an old church among Auvergne volcanoes, with Murol castle and Lac d'Aydat close; the village is small and spread out.
gem:avernes: Small Val-d'Oise village; the only sights on the card are châteaux and churches in neighbouring villages.
gem:pisek: River town with a historic stone bridge, castle and churches; a pleasant walk, though a short one.
gem:abrantes: Tagus town with its castle and the Castelo do Bode lake nearby; the best churches listed are in Sardoal.
gem:castellar-de-la-frontera: Hill village in a protected historic grouping, with the castle and the old Castellar Viejo; small, with few other sights.
gem:campulung: Old Wallachian town under the Carpathians with the Negru Vodă monastery and the Roman camp of Jidava nearby; modest, a short stop.
gem:haderslev: South Jutland town with Haderslev Cathedral and the Damparken lake; a pleasant old centre, quickly seen.
gem:oosterend: Quiet Texel village with two churches and a maritime museum; the dunes national park is eight kilometres off.
gem:navarrenx: Listed fortified village inside its ramparts, with the Saint-Germain church; walls and a short walk, then little more.
gem:el-port-de-la-selva: Fishing village at the edge of Cap de Creus park, with coves and Dalí's Portlligat house eight kilometres away; small but lovely.
gem:breda: Brabant city with the Grote Kerk, a castle and a béguinage; a lively centre for a day, little to fill a second.
gem:aguilar-de-campoo: Listed Palencia town below its castle, with the monastery of Santa María la Real and Romanesque country around; a good half day.
gem:caldas-da-rainha: Spa town with the José Malhoa and ceramics museums, Óbidos and its lagoon 5 to 6 km off; the town itself is ordinary.
gem:saint-bonnet-de-rochefort: Rural Allier village with two railway viaducts, its named churches and castles mostly 7 km off in Gannat; little reason to stop.
gem:s-arenal: Built-up resort at the end of Platja de Palma, Palma Aquarium 4 km off; a beach strip, nothing to see.
gem:hervas: Listed mountain village with a well-kept Jewish quarter, spas and castles within 9 km; a lovely half day, little beyond it.
gem:vila-nova-de-cerveira: Minho riverside town with a castle, town hall and beaches within reach; the card shows a small place of modest scale.
gem:orihuela: Historic-listed city with a cathedral, castle and Holy Week museum; handsome core, though it rewards only a short stop.
gem:osuna: Ducal town with a collegiate church, baroque palaces and the Roman site of Urso; a rewarding half day, quiet after dark.
gem:melle: Poitou town in the Petites Cités de Caractère with three churches, Saint-Hilaire among them; small, a short stop.
gem:belleme: Small listed town in the Perche with its Salvator church; the priory and churches listed are in other villages.
gem:belfort: Garrison city with the Lion de Belfort carved below its citadel; a strong monument in an otherwise plain town.
gem:rewal: Baltic resort village with the clifftop church ruin at Trzęsacz and the Niechorze lighthouse nearby; a beach stop, crowded in summer.
gem:bergues: Flemish town on the list of Les Plus Beaux Détours de France with a tower and churches; compact, with few sights.
gem:gamzigrad: Felix Romuliana, a UNESCO-listed late Roman imperial palace; one remote site in eastern Serbia with little else around.
gem:ager: Listed walled village under the Serra del Montsec, reservoirs within 15 km; a walking base rather than a sight in itself.
gem:alle: Semois valley village near the Frahan meander and the Tombeau du Géant; good walking country, little in the village itself.
gem:coca: Listed Castilian village known for the Castillo de Coca; the card names nothing else, so a visit of an hour or two.
gem:sankt-polten: Baroque cathedral with its museum and the Prandtauer church in a compact centre; a pleasant few hours, little more.
gem:kraslava: Small Latgale town on the Daugava with a manor palace and a Catholic church, near Lake Drīdzis; quiet and soon seen.
gem:arandelovac: Small Šumadija town near Venčac mountain and the Brezovac monastery 6 km off; little to hold a visitor.
gem:thann: Alsace wine town at the foot of the Grand Ballon, near the Hartmannswillerkopf battlefield; the town is quickly seen.
gem:covarrubias: Castilian village with a collegiate church and a historic grouping, and a monastery nearby; a short visit.
gem:olloniego: Small listed village on the edge of Oviedo; every major sight on the card is in Oviedo, seven kilometres away.
gem:mijas: Costa del Sol municipality with a listed hill village below the Sierra de Mijas; pleasant for a few hours, sprawl along the coast.
gem:ibeas-de-juarros: Village by the UNESCO-listed Atapuerca excavations and the Sima del Elefante, San Pedro de Cardeña 7 km off; the site is the visit.
gem:krivoklat: Castle village inside a protected landscape and biosphere reserve, with a coronation chapel; small, a half-day stop.
gem:santa-ponsa: Mallorca resort bay with a small beach and the Puig de Sa Morisca lookout; a holiday strip with no old core.
gem:choirokoitia: UNESCO-listed Neolithic settlement on a hillside; one site that takes an hour or two, the village adds little.
gem:archangelos: Large Rhodes village near Tsambika beach, its monastery and Feraklos castle; a base for the east coast more than a sight.
gem:grajal-de-campos: Listed village with its castle and the San Pedro de las Dueñas monastery, Sahagún 6 km off; a short stop.
gem:fredericia: Danish fortress town with ramparts, a powder tower and Østerstrand beach 1 km off; the Little Belt Bridge lies 5 km away.
gem:covilha: Town on the slopes of the Serra da Estrela with city walls and churches; the mountain, 10 km off, is the real draw.
gem:achterberg: Small Betuwe village with the Cunerakerk and lakes 20 km away; nothing that makes it a destination.
gem:luneville: Lorraine town with the grand Château de Lunéville and the Abbaye Saint-Rémy; the château is worth the stop, the town is quiet.
gem:brioude: Listed Auvergne town built around the Basilique Saint-Julien; one fine church, then little to keep you.
gem:ustka: Baltic beach town with a lighthouse, a local museum and beech woods along the river; a summer seaside stop, little else.
gem:maasdam: Polder village in the Hoeksche Waard; every listed sight is in Dordrecht, 8 km away, so no reason to stop here.
gem:le-locle: UNESCO watchmaking town with the underground mills of Col-des-Roches and a horology museum; a focused half day, not a stay.
gem:kungsbacka: Swedish coastal town whose card lists only parish areas and Kungsbacka church; Rådasjön lake lies 20 km off.
gem:hruba-skala: Castle hamlet among the sandstone towers of the Bohemian Paradise, with Trosky and Kost castles near; the village is only a base.
gem:garmen: Village beside the Roman ruins of Nikopolis ad Nestum, with the Zagrade plane tree; a short stop, little to hold more.
gem:hooghalen: Drenthe village whose draw is the Westerbork camp memorial five kilometres away; the village itself is small and quiet.
gem:laredo: Historic town with the church of Santa María above the long La Salvé beach, Santoña's marshes near; a busy beach town more than a sight.
gem:laxenburg: The Franzensburg in its palace park makes a good half day out of Vienna; little else in the village.
gem:rokytnice-v-orlickych-horach: Eagle Mountains village with a Jewish cemetery and railway museum; the castle and fort lie in other places.
gem:jelenia-gora: Silesian town with an arcaded market square, Śnieżka and the Karkonosze within 20 km; a good base, a modest city.
gem:roquetas-de-mar: Coastal resort city with the Santa Ana castle and a marina; mostly modern holiday blocks, little to draw a visit.
gem:tarcal: Wine village under Tokaj Hill in the UNESCO Tokaj wine region; cellars and vineyards, but little of a village to linger in.
gem:strumica: Market town with a fortress, a cathedral and the Veljusa monastery 8 km away; a short stop, little to hold a night.
gem:poza-de-la-sal: Listed historic village with a castle and salt works; very small, so a short stop rather than a stay.
gem:zuidhoven: Hamlet near Dordrecht and the Biesbosch park 7 km off; the named church and museums belong to Dordrecht, not here.
gem:wladyslawowo: Baltic fishing port and beach resort at the root of the Hel peninsula, near the Rozewie lighthouses; busy in summer, plain otherwise.
gem:neoi-poroi: Small Pierian beach village with Platamon Castle 5 km away and Mount Ossa behind; a summer stop, thin otherwise.
gem:bueu: Galician fishing town on the Ría de Pontevedra with beaches close by; few sights, mostly a coastal stay.
gem:loon-op-zand: Base for the Efteling theme park and the Loonse en Drunense Duinen, both a few km out; the town itself has little to see.
gem:alingsas: Small Swedish town with a local museum and the Anten–Gräfsnäs heritage railway 8 km away; pleasant, but little to draw a visit.
gem:uruena: Listed historic village at 832 m with an intact core; the card shows few sights, so a couple of hours covers it.
gem:castro-caldelas: Listed Galician hill village around the Counts of Lemos castle and its old quarter; a good stop, small for a full day.
gem:pszczyna: Market town around Pszczyna Palace and its gateway, with a neat square and town hall; half a day covers it.
gem:alcazar-de-san-juan: La Mancha town with windmills, the Santa Quiteria square and a knightly order museum; flat, with Campo de Criptana 8 km off.
gem:nachod: Border town below Náchod Castle, with prewar forts and the Babiččino údolí valley nearby; a decent base, plain centre.
gem:korenov: Jizera Mountains village on the Tanvald to Harrachov cog railway, with ski slopes nearby; outdoor base, few sights.
gem:vila-real: Trás-os-Montes town beside the Mateus Palace and its gardens; one fine sight, an ordinary town around it.
gem:frederikshavn: Port town with a powder tower, Bangsbo Museum and boats to the Hirsholmene islands; mostly a ferry stop, little to stay for.
gem:bejar: Listed mountain town at 946 m with its ducal palace, El Bosque estate and listed Candelario near; a half day, quiet otherwise.
gem:shipka: Balkan village near the Shipka Pass with a memorial church and Thracian tombs; Buzludzha is 5 km away, the village itself is small.
gem:hassleholm: Railway junction town in Skåne; Hovdala castle and village churches lie outside, nothing in town to travel for.
gem:larisa: Ancient theatres and the Yeni Mosque make a short walk; a working Thessalian city with few reasons to stay.
gem:hollum: Ameland village with old island houses, the lighthouse and a lifeboat museum; peaceful, a few hours of interest.
gem:smederevo: City on UNESCO's tentative list with a few old churches; the card names little else, so a short stop.
gem:lorca: Castillo de Lorca over a core of churches and the Palacio de Guevara; a rewarding half day in an otherwise ordinary city.
gem:lovas: Small village near Lake Balaton in the Balaton Uplands geopark; few sights of its own, the lake is the draw.
gem:serres: Macedonian city with an archaeological museum, Ottoman mosques and an acropolis; a plain modern fabric, quickly done.
gem:hellevoetsluis: Old fortified naval port with the Jan Blanken dry dock and the Haringvliet dam 6 km away; a pleasant walk, not a day.
gem:velhartice: Small village below Velhartice Castle, with a Jewish cemetery and the Šumava foothills around; one castle visit, then little else.
gem:malinska: Island resort village on Krk with beaches; Biserujka cave lies 10 km away, little else to see.
gem:tobed: Tiny Aragon village with a UNESCO-listed Mudéjar church and a castle ruin; worth an hour on the way, no more.
gem:sliven: Bulgarian city below the Karandila heights with a regional museum; the card names no sight worth a trip.
gem:nietap: Small Groningen village with a church and two mills 5 km out; lakes nearby, but little in the village itself.
gem:assen: Provincial capital with the Drents Museum and the old houses of the Brink; a good museum visit, little else to hold a day.
gem:almere-stad: New town on reclaimed land by the Gooimeer, near the Lepelaarplassen birding lakes; modern planning, little reason to visit.
gem:malmkoping: Small Södermanland village with a museum tramway and country churches nearby; nothing to plan a trip around.
gem:brihuega: Historic-listed town with a royal cloth factory and castle; small and quiet, a good half day.
gem:cieszyn: Town with a Piast tower, Saint Nicholas Rotunda and several churches; handsome and compact, but a day covers it.
gem:san-millan-de-la-cogolla: Two UNESCO monasteries, Suso and Yuso, in a hamlet of 303 people; the site is the draw, little else to do.
gem:culla: Hilltop Maestrat village at 1,065 m with a listed historic core and the Salvador church; a fine hour or two, remote and quiet.
gem:lovech: Balkan town with its covered bridge, the Varosha old quarter and the Hisarya fortress; a pleasant half day, little beyond.
gem:grolloo: Quiet Drenthe hamlet within reach of Kamp Westerbork and the dolmens; the village itself offers little.
gem:sandnes: Norwegian city with churches, a runic inscription and nearby beaches; pleasant, but the card shows few sights worth a trip.
gem:pazin: Pazin Castle stands over the cave and chasm in the middle of Istria; the rest of the small town holds little.
gem:gouwsluis: Village by the Gouwe lift bridge, with lakes such as the Braassemermeer within 9 km; pleasant for cycling, little to see itself.
gem:pleven: Bulgarian city known for its Siege of Plevna panorama, history museum and park; the rest of the centre is plain.
gem:wijk-bij-duurstede: Old town on the Lek with Duurstede Castle, the Rijn en Lek windmill and Museum Dorestad; a pleasant half day.
gem:lidkoping: Swedish town whose card lists only surrounding parishes and Villa Giacomina; too little on record to rate it as more than a stop.
gem:nyborg: Danish town beside Nyborg Castle with a historic merchant house and a beach; Holckenhavn castle nearby, a short visit.
gem:corofin: Quiet village at the edge of the Burren, near Dysert O'Dea and ring forts; a walking base, with little in the village itself.
gem:sanok: Carpathian foothill town with its castle, an Orthodox cathedral and a museum of folk architecture; an easy halt, not a long stay.
gem:hohenems: Vorarlberg town with a palace, castle ruins and the Jewish Museum; modest in scale, and sights are spread out.
gem:noia: Galician estuary town with the Gothic Santa María a Nova and medieval walls; a good half day, beaches a short drive away.
gem:cinfaes: Rural municipality at 404 m with its parish church and the São Cristóvão de Nogueira church 3 km off; little to hold a visit.
gem:sint-truiden: Flemish town with a beguinage and a Gothic church; the centre is modest and the list of sights short.
gem:tonsberg: Fortress ruins on Slottsfjellet above the harbour and the cathedral; a pleasant coastal town, thin for a full stay.
gem:place: Village below Skopska Crna Gora with Gornjane monastery and Banjane churches near, Scupi 8 km away; little to hold a visit itself.
gem:tripoli: Arcadian market town with an archaeological museum; ancient Tegea lies 7 km out and the centre holds little else.
gem:baska: Krk island village with Paradise Beach and a church of Saint Lucy; the draw is the sea, and little else is here.
gem:burriana: Orange-growing town on the Castellón coast with a listed historic core; the named sights lie in neighbouring towns, little to keep you.
gem:bergun: Alpine village at 1,372 m below Piz Ela, with a local museum; the Landwasser Viaduct lies 8 km away.
gem:andermatt: Alpine village at 1,441 m below the Gemsstock, with the Devil's Bridge and Gotthard Pass near; a fine mountain base more than a sight itself.
gem:zlin: Bata's company city with its skyscraper, memorial and castle; of interest to architecture fans, otherwise little to hold a visit.
gem:burgh: Dune village on Schouwen with Slot Haamstede and the Plompe Toren, 4 km from the Westerlichttoren; quiet beaches, little to fill a second day.
gem:liptovsky-mikulas: Mountain gateway town with Chopok and Ďumbier 15 km away, the Demänovská ice cave and a lake; the town itself is modest.
gem:bergen-op-zoom: Brabant city with the Markiezenhof palace, a prison gate and a church; a modest centre, seen in half a day.
gem:skovde: Swedish town below the Billingen plateau, with listed sights that are mostly parish churches; pleasant but quiet.
gem:hajduszoboszlo: Spa town built around the Aqua-Palace baths and pools; a place to soak, with a Reformed church and little else to see.
gem:tvrdosin: UNESCO-listed wooden church of All Saints, Orava reservoir 5 km off; one fine sight in an ordinary town.
gem:lipnice-nad-sazavou: Hill village under a castle with a wide view, and the Jaroslav Hašek museum; a good hour or two, little more.
gem:luanco: Asturian fishing town with a listed old quarter and the Museo Marítimo de Asturias; pleasant for a few hours, not more.
gem:moigrad-porolissum: Hamlet of 516 around the Roman fort of Porolissum, a UNESCO-listed site; the visit is the ruins, with little else nearby.
gem:roma: Gotland farming village with the Roma royal estate and medieval country churches around; little to hold more than a short stop.
gem:ouddorp: Beach village on Goeree with dunes, the Westhoofd lighthouse and Lake Grevelingen 9 km away; a family seaside base, plain itself.
gem:libesice: Hop-country village with Líčkov Castle and a Jewish cemetery, Žatec 7 km away; little to stop for on its own.
gem:spisska-stara-ves: Base 3 km from the Dunajec gorge and the Three Crowns in Pieniny National Park; the village itself offers little.
gem:lindos: Acropolis with an ancient theatre above a village and St. Paul's beach; a rewarding half day, crowded in season.
gem:snezne: Quiet upland village with rock outcrops and ponds nearby; the card shows nothing of its own to plan a visit around.
gem:tolmin: Soča valley base under Krn and Vogel, with Lake Bohinj 15 km off; fine for outdoor days, the village itself is plain.
gem:kranevo: Beach village between Albena and Golden Sands, near the rock-cut Aladzha monastery; resort coast with little of its own.
gem:hradec-kralove: East Bohemian city with a Gothic cathedral, the White Tower and a modern art gallery; tidy and calm, with few big sights.
gem:pathmos: A district of Enschede within reach of the Rijksmuseum Twenthe; the city's sights, not a place to travel to on its own.
gem:lanaye: Hamlet by Fort Eben-Emael, with Eijsden Castle across the border; a fort visit, not a stay.
gem:joensuu: University town in North Karelia with a provincial museum and lakes 20 km off; practical stop, little to see.
