gem:mikkeli: Lakeland town with a cathedral, the Savilahti stone sacristy and an infantry museum; a plain centre, quickly seen.
gem:kampinos: Village on the edge of Kampinos national park, a biosphere reserve; the Niepokalanów basilica lies eight kilometres off.
gem:lejre: Village with the Lejre Museum, eight kilometres from Roskilde Cathedral; most named sights belong to Roskilde.
gem:saldus: Latvian town with St. John's Church, Kalnmuiža manor and a lake 1.5 km away; the card names few sights.
gem:vevey: Lake Geneva town below Mont Pèlerin, 8 km from the Lavaux vineyard terraces; a fine base, the town itself is quiet and polished.
gem:batenburg: Tiny Maas-side village with a post mill and castle tags; a pleasant stop on a bike ride, not a day out.
gem:figueira-da-foz: Atlantic beach resort with a casino and the Buarcos fort; broad sands for a summer stay, little to see beyond them.
gem:lemmer: Lake-port town with the UNESCO-listed Wouda steam pumping station and Frisian lakes around; a sailing base, short on other sights.
gem:borgholm: Seaside village on Öland beneath the ruins of Borgholm Castle, with a bathhouse on the shore; summer-led, quiet outside it.
gem:gasawa: Lakeland village by the Biskupin settlement site and the Wenecja castle ruin; a few hours for the open-air site, little else.
gem:gyula: Town of the Gyula Castle and the Church of the Assumption; one main sight, little else.
gem:szczawno-zdroj: Quiet spa village in wooded hills, close to Książ castle; the main sights lie in neighbouring towns, so more base than goal.
gem:almelo: Twente town with the Bellinckhof and a few mills nearby; a plain modern centre with nothing to keep you.
gem:boijl: Quiet hamlet near the colony villages of Frederiksoord and Wilhelminaoord and a basket-weaving museum; a stop on a cycle route.
gem:horstermeer: Polder hamlet near the Naardermeer reserve and Amsterdam's forts; a cycling stop, nothing to come for.
gem:krynica-zdroj: Spa town with the Nikifor museum and wooden churches in Tylicz and Powroźnik nearby; a pleasant stay, few sights in town.
gem:konopiste: Konopiště castle and its park outside Benešov; essentially one sight, worth a half-day trip from Prague.
gem:sonntag: Mountain farming area in the Grosses Walsertal biosphere reserve, below the Rote Wand; quiet walking, few named sights.
gem:novalja: Island resort on Pag with Zrće party beach 3 km away and other beaches near; a summer nightlife base, little else.
gem:usti-nad-labem: Elbe city with Střekov Castle, a zoo and an opera theatre; Milešovka mountain lies 14 km away, and the fabric is mixed.
gem:vindeln: Small Norrland village on the Vindel river and its rapids, in a biosphere reserve; quiet nature, little else to see.
gem:ljungby: Småland town with a saga museum and a runestone; a plain stop on the road with nothing to hold you.
gem:golem: Albanian beach settlement near Durrës; the card shows zero residents, and the sights it lists are 7 km away.
gem:arinsal: High mountain village under Coma Pedrosa, a base for ski and summer hikes; resort building and the sights lie down the valley.
gem:male-brezno: Small village in the Bohemian uplands near Ústí; its listed castles are in neighbouring places, nothing here to stop for.
gem:pardubice: City with its castle, Saint Bartholomew's church and Kunětice Mountain Castle 5 km out; a decent half day, little beyond.
gem:chernomorets: Black Sea beach village 5 km from Sozopol's old town and its archaeological museum; beach days, little of its own.
gem:hokksund: Small Drammen-river town with old churches and a glass museum; filed as an area, it is an ordinary town with little to draw a visit.
gem:borlange: Industrial Dalarna town whose listed sights are parish churches outside the centre; a place to pass through rather than visit.
gem:rb-k: Danish village among manors, with Glorup Manor 6 km and Holckenhavn Castle 8 km away; little in the village itself.
gem:nunspeet: Veluwe town near the Veluwemeer and Zandenplas beach; the theme parks and castles listed lie in other places.
gem:ede: Dutch commuter city with windmills, a church and Veluwe walking 9 km out; little in the centre to hold a visit.
gem:hudiksvall: Swedish coastal town with a regional museum and parish churches nearby; the card shows little to hold a visit.
gem:zalaegerszeg: Hungarian county seat with a theatre, a village museum and a thermal bath; a few sights, little to hold a visit.
gem:tomelilla: Scanian village among small churches and Bollerup Castle 8 km away; quiet farmland, little to hold a visit.
gem:eisenstadt: Burgenland capital around the Esterházy palace, with the Haydn house and a domed church; handsome sights, but a small town.
gem:levoca: Walled Spiš town around the Saint James church and old town square; rich for its size, though a day is plenty.
gem:garsnas: Österlen village with Glimmingehus castle 6 km and beaches such as Haväng within 19 km; a base, with nothing of its own to see.
gem:sever-do-vouga: Rural Portuguese municipality with pillories and megalithic tombs scattered around; quiet countryside, with no single centre to visit.
gem:spilion: Cretan mountain village with a Venetian fountain, Preveli beach and bridge within 10 km; a pleasant stop on the road south.
gem:trelleborg: Swedish port town on the south coast with scattered churches and an art hall; beaches nearby, but little to see.
gem:fossbergom: Ottadalen village with the Lom stave church and the Prestfossen falls, Glittertind 21 km away; a mountain gateway, short on sights.
gem:pazardzhik: Plains city with a clock tower, a history museum and the Tell Yunatsite mound nearby; few sights for a visitor's day.
gem:agios-nikolaos: Cretan harbour town around Lake Voulismeni, with beaches and the Lato ruins six kilometres away; pretty, but resort-minded.
gem:harlosa: Scanian farm village whose card lists only parish churches, some 4 to 8 km away; little to see in the village.
gem:glinado: Inland Naxos village; the Portara and the archaeological museum are 4 to 5 km away in the main town, little here itself.
gem:vastervik: Swedish coastal town with Stegeholm castle ruin, a town hall and boatmen's cottages; a calm harbour stop with limited sights.
gem:podgorzyn: Sudeten village below Chojnik Castle, with Śnieżka summit 11.5 km away and a national park around; a walking base.
gem:launsdorf: Carinthian village below Burg Hochosterwitz on Austria's UNESCO tentative list, with Längsee 3 km away; little else in the village.
gem:darp: Drenthe hamlet in heath and woods, Steenwijk's church and museum 6 km off; nothing of its own to visit.
gem:appingedam: Old Groningen canal town with a synagogue and Museum Mohlmann, among village churches on mounds; a pleasant hour or two.
gem:zanka: Lakeside village with a public beach on Lake Balaton and the Hegyestű hill 3 km away; a summer swim stop, little else.
gem:jastarnia: Fishing and resort village on the Hel Peninsula, with a fishermen's museum and old bunkers; a beach base, little else.
gem:de-cocksdorp: Island village near the Eierland lighthouse and wide North Sea beaches; a calm base for cycling, little in the village itself.
gem:drachten: Modern Frisian town with a local museum and a park; the lakes and estates are outside, not a destination.
gem:varybobi: Leafy Athens suburb by the Tatoi palace and the Air Force Museum; a residential edge with nothing to hold a visitor.
gem:karlshamn: Blekinge port town with the Carl Gustafs church and country churches round about; a quiet stop with little to fill a day.
gem:gniezno: Its Primatial cathedral and Lech Hill give real historic weight; beyond them a modest city, a day is plenty.
gem:winsum: Tiny Frisian village with windmills nearby and Franeker's planetarium 7 km away; little of its own.
gem:raksta: Stockholm-area village by Tyresö Palace, 4 km from Tyresta National Park; a suburban outing rather than a destination.
gem:koge: Old market town with its town hall, the Køge Museum and Vallø Castle 6 km off; a pleasant half day, little more.
gem:kraliky: Mountain village near Králický Sněžník with a bunker casemate and trails nearby; scenic, but quiet and spread out.
gem:tata: Lakeside town with Tata Castle on Lake Öreg, Calvary Hill and caves nearby; a pleasant half day, little for longer.
gem:warten: Small Frisian lakeside village near Leeuwarden with a windmill nearby; peaceful, but little to do.
gem:sid: Srem border town filed as an area, with a few churches and the Privina Glava monastery 6 km out; little to draw a visit.
gem:palaia-epidavros: Small harbour village 8 km from the ancient theatre and Asclepius sanctuary of Epidaurus; a calm base, with little of its own.
gem:alexandroupoli: Thracian port city with an ethnological museum and a seafront; a transit stop, with little else named to see.
gem:salamina: Island town opposite Piraeus with an archaeological museum and Phaneromeni monastery; built-up and ordinary, little reason to cross.
gem:egmond-aan-zee: North Sea beach village between dunes, with Alkmaar's museums 8 km away; beach days, little of its own to see.
gem:quin: Clare village with the ruined Franciscan Quin Abbey, near Mooghaun ringfort and Ennis Abbey; an hour's stop, little more.
gem:desinic: Small Croatian village with the Veliki Tabor fort on the tentative UNESCO list, Olimje monastery 8 km away; very quiet.
gem:delden: Dutch village with the Twickel estate and a salt museum; Hengelo's station and sights are six kilometres off.
gem:wedde: Westerwolde village with the restored Burcht Wedde and a smock mill; an hour's stop, flat country around.
gem:roermond: Maas town with the Munsterkerk, a cathedral and the Maasplassen lakes nearby; a pleasant day, not much more.
gem:hornu: Grand-Hornu, a UNESCO-listed colliery and workers' estate, is a strong two-hour visit; the town around it has little else.
gem:alatskivi: Hamlet built around the neo-Gothic Alatskivi manor, Lake Peipus about 22 km away; worth a detour for the house, then little else.
gem:laax: Alpine village base with peaks such as Crap Sogn Gion and the Crestasee nearby; the village itself holds little beyond the Türalihus.
gem:motala: Lakeside Östergötland town with a church and a few manors nearby; a plain place, more stop than goal.
gem:zutphen: Old town with the Berkelpoort, the Broederenkerk and the Wijnhuistoren; a fine intact centre for a day, little beyond it.
gem:callantsoog: North Holland beach village with a village church and dunes; the windmills and churches listed are in other villages.
gem:chudenice: Small Czech village with a château and a viewpoint rated well on the card; Švihov Castle lies 8 km off, little else.
gem:vouzela: Small town with its pillory and Misericórdia church, the São Pedro do Sul Roman baths nearby; a short stop.
gem:tatabanya: Caves and the Turul monument on the edge of a modern industrial city; little here makes a centre worth a stop.
gem:drobak: White wooden fjord town facing Oscarsborg fortress, where the cruiser Blücher sank; a pleasant day trip, quiet otherwise.
gem:baja: Danube-side Hungarian town with a Franciscan friary, a town hall and a long bridge; modest, soon seen.
gem:krk: Island town with its cathedral and Frankopan castle by the sea, and the Košljun monastery near; pleasant, but compact.
gem:angelholm: Skåne coast town known for its UFO memorial, Kullaberg within 25 km; a beach stop with little to see in town.
gem:egkomi: The card mixes a Nicosia suburb with Famagusta's St Barnabas monastery and Othello's Tower; little of its own to visit.
gem:landskrona: Coastal town with its Citadel and Sofia Albertina church; a few hours' stop, little to hold a night.
gem:lappi: Finnish parish village near the UNESCO-listed Sammallahdenmäki site, 4 km away; the church is its other sight.
gem:carlow: Irish county town with a cathedral, a castle ruin and the Brownshill Dolmen 3 km out; one of many alike, quickly done.
gem:srednja-vas-v-bohinju: Alpine village by Lake Bohinj, 5 km away, with the Savica waterfall and Triglav within reach; a quiet base in a national park.
gem:gars-am-kamp: Kamp valley village in a geopark, near Rosenburg castle and Altenburg abbey; gentle and green, with a short list of sights.
gem:diever: Drenthe village by woods and heath, the Dwingeloo radio telescope 7 km off; good for cycling, little to see.
gem:montalegre: Highland Portuguese town with a castle and a pillory, beside Peneda-Gerês country; the card's zero population is wrong.
gem:boden: Garrison town in Norrbotten with its fortress and Överluleå church; a rail stop rather than a place to visit.
gem:ronse: Town in the Flemish Ardennes with the Sint-Hermes basilica and the Koppenberg and Paterberg climbs nearby; for cyclists more than sightseers.
gem:neuchatel: Lakeside town with a castle, the Collégiale and art and history museums, the Laténium 4 km off; handsome but quiet, a day covers it.
gem:mirandela: Small Portuguese river town with a castle, a palace and an old station; pleasant for a stop, thin for more.
gem:skj-rhalden: Harbour village of the Hvaler islands with a stone church and the Homlungen lighthouse; skerries and quiet, little to do in town.
gem:holb-k: Fjord-side Zealand town with a local museum and Eriksholm castle nearby; plain and quickly done.
gem:loppersum: Groningen village with a large medieval church, among other old churches on terps; a short stop for church lovers.
gem:ustron: Spa town in the Silesian Beskids with peaks such as Skrzyczne within reach; a hiking base with a modest centre.
gem:zuzemberk: Slovenian village with a castle on the Krka; Stara Soteska castle lies 9 km away, and the village itself is small.
gem:drammen: Norwegian river city with a large church, a museum and two manors; useful stop, with a modest centre.
gem:rupite: Hamlet below the Kozhuh hill with the ruins of Heraclea Sintica; a short visit, with little else in the village.
gem:willemstad: Small waterside town with a fort, mill and domed church; very little beyond the old defences.
gem:vila-franca-de-xira: Riverside town known for its Campino monument and pillory, with Torres Vedras lines nearby; a commuter town, little to stay for.
gem:revfulop: North-shore Lake Balaton resort village near Badacsony hill; swimming and wine in summer, little of its own to see.
gem:polhov-gradec: Small Slovenian village with a manor and castle, and the Tošč hill three kilometres off; peaceful, but little to do.
gem:kragujevac: Large city with the old church, a historic theatre and a cathedral; little else in its centre to hold a visit.
gem:kongsvinger: Norwegian town with a fortress and a church; the card holds little else to keep a visitor.
gem:gytheio: Harbour town on the Laconian Gulf with the Kranai islet lighthouse, a Roman theatre and the Dimitrios wreck nearby; a pleasant stop, modest sights.
gem:tulln: Danube town with the Egon Schiele Museum, the Minoritenkirche and Roman Comagena remains; a pleasant half day, modest otherwise.
gem:zamardi: Lake Balaton resort village with its Nagystrand beach 2 km away; Tihany Abbey lies 6 km off, and the village is mostly a beach stay.
gem:nykobing-sj-lland: Coastal Zealand village near dolmens and a windmill at Rørvig; quiet, but nothing here to hold a second day.
gem:aleksinac: Serbian town in the Morava valley with a lake 11 km off; the card names nothing here that is worth a trip.
gem:rauna: Rural parish with castle ruins, a Lutheran church and Tanīskalns hillfort; a short stop on a drive, little to hold more.
gem:eisden: Limburg mining town with a miner's house museum, the Hoge Kempen National Park 7 km away; a base for walks, little to see.
gem:balatonalmadi: Lake Balaton resort town with beaches, a Jesuit church and a stronghold church; a summer lakeside stay, light on sights.
gem:baia-mare: Mining city with Stephen's Tower, churches and an ethnographic museum, a gateway to Maramureș; the centre is quickly seen.
gem:somoskoujfalu: Border village in a geopark with Šomoška castle and a basalt cataract; scenic and quiet, but a short list of sights.
gem:arkhaia-korinthos: Ancient Corinth's Temple of Apollo and the Acrocorinth fortress above; the modern village around them is plain.
gem:zalakaros: Small village near the Little Balaton wetland and a buffalo reserve; a place to rest, not to explore.
gem:smolyan: Rhodope mountain town near Pamporovo and the Snezhanka peak; a long, plain town that serves as a base.
gem:rostanga: Small village by national park woodland, with village churches around; a quiet base for walks, little to see in it.
gem:groede: Small Zeeland Flanders village near the North Sea coast; its listed mills and sights are in neighbouring places.
gem:lozenets: Black Sea beach village with sandy coves near Tsarevo; a summer resort with no sights of its own.
gem:trnava: Walled Slovak town of many churches, with the cathedral of St John the Baptist and a city tower; a good day trip, not a stay.
gem:trebnje: Small Lower Carniola town with castles such as Lanšprež and Rakovnik within 8 km; little to see in the town itself.
gem:botosani: Moldavian city with the Popăuți Monastery, a theatre and memorial houses; a modest centre, not one to travel for.
gem:megchelen: Border village with Huis Landfort, close to the Wasserburg Anholt moated castle; a short stop, not a destination.
gem:satov: Wine village on the Austrian border; every named sight on the card is in Znojmo, seven kilometres away.
gem:ornskoldsvik: Coastal town with the Paradiskullen ski slope over the bay; few sights on the card for a visitor's day.
gem:liptovsky-hradok: Liptov town with a small castle, a base for the Low Tatras peaks of Ďumbier and Chopok and the Liptovská Mara lake; little in town.
gem:ronne: Bornholm's main town with several local museums, a theatre and a beach, and prehistoric stones nearby; pleasant, if low-key.
gem:liapades: Corfu village 3 km from Paleokastritsa's monastery and 5 km from Angelokastro castle; a quiet base, little in the village itself.
gem:hinterbruhl: Vienna Woods village with the Seegrotte underground lake and Liechtenstein Castle; good for a half-day outing, not a stay.
gem:vrboska: Small harbour village on Hvar with a castle and the Stari Grad plain next door; the place itself is brief.
gem:pegeia: Hillside village above Coral Bay with the Adonis Baths 5 km off; a beach base, little to see in the village.
gem:nauders: Tyrolean resort at the Reschen pass with the Festung Nauders and Schloss Naudersberg; a mountain base more than a sight.
gem:harnosand: Swedish coastal town built round a cathedral and chapter house; small, with a short list of sights.
gem:tranebjerg: Main village of Samsø with a windmill and the Vesborg ruins 8 km off; a quiet island stop, little to see in the village.
gem:dzhebel: Small Bulgarian town in the Rhodopes with a rock site 5 km away; the card holds almost nothing to judge.
gem:silistra: Town with a Roman tomb, the Drastar fortress remains and Mecidiye Tabia; interesting for a few hours, little else.
gem:warffum: Groningen terp village with old churches around and the Menkemaborg eight kilometres away; a short stop on a cycling day.
gem:sligo: Base for the Carrowmore tombs, Knocknarea and Drumcliff, with two cathedrals in town; the town itself is ordinary.
gem:huttenberg: Small upland village at 880 m with the Heinrich Harrer Museum and a mining museum; little to hold more than a few hours.
gem:mesolongi: Lagoon town on the Missolonghi–Aitoliko wetlands, remembered for its sieges; the lagoon is the draw, the town is plain.
gem:skien: Norwegian river city with several churches and the Ibsen museum 4 km away; quiet and modest in its historic fabric.
gem:ruurlo: Achterhoek village with the moated Kasteel Huize Ruurlo and a village church; a cycling stop, not a day out.
gem:hukvaldy: Village below a large castle ruin, with the Leoš Janáček memorial and Štramberk 8 km away; a pleasant half day, not more.
gem:vranje: Serbian city with a white bridge and a church; its UNESCO creative-city title is for music, and the sights are few.
gem:bauska: Small Latvian town with Bauska Castle and a manor nearby; worth a stop, though the rest is a quiet provincial centre.
gem:vransko: Small roadside village with Žovnek Castle a few kilometres away; Velika planina is near, but the village itself holds little.
gem:fagersta: Small town with Västanfors church, an old power station and lake Åmänningen 11 km off; little reason to come.
gem:hunnebostrand: Small coastal harbour village by a national park, beaches within 13 km; a summer stop, the card names no sight of its own.
gem:ehenbichl: Lech valley village below Ehrenberg Castle, with the Alpsee 10 km away; a practical Tyrol base, little life of its own.
gem:rijssen: Dutch town whose card lists a station and a church; little here makes a reason to stop.
gem:trutnov: Gateway town to the Krkonoše with Sněžka 23 km off; the named sights are outlying bunkers and forts, little in town itself.
gem:kandava: Castle mound and old church above the Abava valley nature park; a short stop rather than a destination.
gem:alteveer: Drenthe peat-colony hamlet whose named sights all lie elsewhere; flat farmland and nothing here to travel for.
gem:balassagyarmat: Border town on the Ipoly with the Palóc Museum of folk culture; worth an hour for the museum, otherwise ordinary.
gem:frymburk: Lakeside village on the Lipno Reservoir with St Bartholomew's church; a summer water base, few sights of its own.
gem:stavern: Small coastal town with the Fredriksvern naval base and Minnehallen memorial; a summer stroll, with Kaupang 5 km out.
gem:teigebyen: Rural locality near Gardermoen with country churches and an aircraft collection; nothing that makes it a destination.
gem:genarp: Rural Scanian village with its parish church and others nearby; farmland and quiet, but no reason to make the trip.
gem:jagodina: Central Serbian town with an old church and the Jošanica monastery ten kilometres away; few reasons to stop.
gem:spital-am-pyhrn: Alpine village with a collegiate church and the Gleinkersee lake close by; little in the village itself beyond a short stop.
gem:vila-real-de-santo-antonio: Pombaline grid town on the Guadiana with long beaches close by; the planned centre is seen in an hour.
gem:haaksbergen: Twente town with a museum tramway, a watermill and the Pancratius church; pleasant countryside, little to make a trip of.
gem:aluksne: Small Latvian town on Lake Alūksne with Temple Hill and old hillforts; a calm lakeside stop with modest sights.
gem:buzau: Romanian city with a communal palace, an ethnographic house collection and a church; the card holds few named sights.
gem:oirschot: Brabant town with a chapel and old watermills and windmills around; a pleasant square, little to fill a day.
gem:fonyod: Lake Balaton beach town facing the Badacsony hill; a summer bathing base, few sights beyond the shore.
gem:kumanovo: Regional city with a clock tower, a mosque and an icon gallery; little to draw a visitor beyond a short stop.
gem:stykkisholmur: Icelandic village whose card lists only the Helgafell hill 4 km away; too little on record to rate it above a quiet stop.
gem:dadia: Village at the gate of the Dadia-Lefkimi-Soufli national park forest; a calm base for nature, with little to see in the village.
gem:pliska: Ruins of the Great Basilica and Pliska fortress lie 3 to 4 km out, with menhirs nearby; the village itself has little else.
gem:torres-vedras: Market town under its castle and the São Vicente fort, with Atlantic beaches 15 to 24 km away; a working town, not a goal.
gem:salasu-de-sus: Village in the Hațeg UNESCO geopark near the Sânpetru fossil beds and Kendeffy castle; few sights of its own beyond a village church.
gem:rakovica: Small village with the Barać caves close by and the Plitvice lakes within 15 km; a place to sleep, not a sight.
gem:targoviste: Royal Court ruins and the Chindia Tower of the old Wallachian capital, with Dealu monastery near; the town around is drab.
gem:nowa-slupia: Village at the foot of Holy Cross, with its monastery and national park museum 3 km away; the hill is the visit, the village little.
gem:portel: Alentejo hill town below its castle; a short stop on quiet roads, little else on record to hold you.
gem:dobrna: Small Styrian spa village built around the Terme Dobrna baths; restful, but nothing to see beyond the spa.
gem:christoupoli: Attica village 9 km from the sanctuary of Artemis at Brauron, with a wildlife park near; little of its own to see.
gem:sonderborg: Sønderborg Castle and the Dybbøl mill and battlefield centre; a solid half day of history, plain beyond it.
gem:hojer: Marsh village by the Wadden Sea park with its mill and water tower; Schackenborg castle lies 7 km away.
gem:tulcea: Low-lying port city with the Azizie mosque and the ruins of Aegyssus; few sights in town, more a starting point than a goal.
gem:hollviken: Skåne coastal suburb with beaches and village churches around; quiet seaside, but little beyond.
gem:sloup-v-cechach: Bohemian village with a rock castle and beech woods round about; a short stop, little else to do.
gem:manger: Coastal village north of Bergen with an emigration centre and heathland centre nearby; quiet, with little to draw a visit.
gem:cambron-saint-vincent: A small Hainaut village known mainly for the Pairi Daiza zoo, a large draw on its own; the village itself has little else.
gem:faliraki: Rhodes beach resort near Anthony Quinn Bay; good sand and sea, but a built-up strip with no old core or sights.
gem:byrum: Main village of the quiet island of Læsø, with its saltworks and lookout tower; a slow island stop with few sights.
gem:svilajnac: Serbian town on the plain whose card names only two village churches nearby; too little known to call it worth a trip.
gem:valtice: Wine town with Valtice Castle in the Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, Lednice Castle 8 km away; a fine day, quiet as a stay.
gem:valmiera: Castle ruins and Saint Simon's church give a short historic walk; a modest Latvian town with little to hold a night.
gem:idanha-a-nova: Vast border municipality holding Monsanto and the Roman site of Idanha-a-Velha; rewarding but far-flung and sparsely served.
gem:heiligenblut: Alpine village on the Grossglockner High Alpine Road, the Grossglockner 12 km off; grand mountains, a small place for a night or two.
gem:hyllestad: Quiet fjord district with a millstone park, an old church and the Gygrekjeften rocks; little to fill more than a stop.
gem:brienzwiler: Mountain village by the Ballenberg open-air museum, Brienzer Rothorn and Reichenbach Falls near; a good base, little in the village.
gem:kalyves: Cretan beach village with ancient Aptera and the Izzedin fortress 3 km away; easy days by the sea, little of its own.
gem:polanczyk: Holiday village with wooden Greek Catholic churches in the villages around; a summer lake stop, little of its own.
gem:nakskov: Small port town with a runestone and Halsted Priory in the countryside around; few reasons to stay.
gem:dobra: Rural village on the edge of Łódź, whose listed churches and palace lie 6 to 7 km away in the city; no reason to visit.
gem:arraiolos: Alentejo town under the Castelo de Arraiolos, with a convent and dolmens nearby; a couple of hours covers it.
gem:poysdorf: Weinviertel wine village with parish churches around and the Staatz castle ruin 11 km off; pleasant for wine, not a destination.
gem:rimburg: Small Dutch border village with a castle; the sights listed lie 5 to 8 km away and the village itself is thin.
gem:rosegg: Drau valley village with Schloss Rosegg and a castle ruin, 10 km from the Ossiach and Wörthersee lakes; a short stop.
gem:tidan: Small Swedish village with rune stones and parish churches around; peaceful, but nothing here to detour for.
gem:hoogmade: Tiny Dutch village near the Kagerplassen lakes; Leiden's museums lie 6 to 7 km away, with little in the village.
gem:novigrad: Istrian harbour town on a small peninsula with the church of St Pelagius; a pretty seafront, few sights beyond it.
gem:heijen: Maas village near Gennep with a windmill; the castle ruin and museum listed lie in other towns.
gem:aalst: Flemish city with a belfry and Affligem Abbey 6 km away; a few hours at most, overshadowed by nearby historic cities.
gem:haskovo: Provincial city with a Virgin Mary monument and the Charshiyska mosque; a thin list of sights, little reason to stop.
gem:viborg: Old Danish town with its great cathedral, the Skovgaard Museum and lakes at its edge; a pleasant day, little beyond it.
gem:sobotka: Village in the Bohemian Paradise with Kost castle four kilometres away and Trosky at seven; a green, quiet base for walks.
gem:mladenovac: Serbian town south of Belgrade filed with zero population; Pavlovac Monastery lies 8 km away and the card holds little else.
gem:elafonisos: Small Greek island with beaches and the sunken site of Pavlopetri nearby; the card is thin on what the village itself offers.
gem:odder: East Jutland town with a local museum and the Rathlousdal estate; beaches 15 km off, nothing that makes it a destination.
gem:midsland: Island village near the Wadden Sea, five kilometres from the Brandaris lighthouse; a calm base for beaches, little in the village itself.
gem:decin: Elbe town with a chateau and the Pastýřská stěna lookout, six kilometres from Bohemian Switzerland; a good base, plain in itself.
gem:tempio-pausania: Sardinian town in the Borghi più belli list at the foot of Monte Limbara, with dolmens and two museums; modest sights.
gem:giglio: Listed island commune with a walled hilltop village, the Rocca and Saracen towers; lovely coast, but known widely for the Costa Concordia wreck.
gem:posada: Sardinian village on the borghi list with a coastal tower and beaches close by; few sights of its own.
gem:toul: Gothic cathedral, Saint-Gengoult collegiate church and old town gate in a walled Lorraine town; quiet streets, done in half a day.
gem:argentan: Norman town with the Saint-Germain church, an abbey and a few old houses; a short stop, little to hold a day.
gem:limoux: Aude town in the Plus Beaux Détours list; Alet Cathedral and its old abbey lie 7 km away, with little else to hold a stay.
gem:roscoff: Granite harbour town of character on the Breton coast, with Saint-Pol-de-Léon's cathedral 5 km away; a fine night, little more.
gem:sterzing: Listed Alpine town at 948 m with its Zwölferturm gate tower and Reifenstein castle near; a good stop, small for more.
gem:atzara: Listed Sardinian village with the Ortiz Echagüe art museum and nuraghi nearby; a short stop in a quiet interior.
gem:seborga: Tiny listed hill village above the Riviera; the sights on the card all lie in towns below it.
gem:poppi: Listed Casentino hill village near the Camaldoli forests; most museums and churches listed lie in nearby towns.
gem:seborga-it: Tiny Ligurian hill village with an orange-flag label; its listed gardens, villas and castle lie in towns 5 to 8 km away.
gem:candelo: Piedmont borgo più bello 5 km from Biella and its cathedral; an hour's stroll, most listed sights are in Biella.
gem:trevi: Listed Umbrian village with old palazzi, close to the Tempietto del Clitunno and the Clitunno springs; little of its own after an hour.
gem:monte-argentario: Promontory facing the Orbetello lagoon, with Forte Filippo and an aquarium; a coastal base, its named sights mostly 8 km off.
gem:sadali: Small listed Sardinian mountain village with old churches; few named sights, a short stop on the way through Barbagia.
gem:chateaudun: Château de Châteaudun and several old churches in a listed detour town; a half day, then little else.
gem:montreuil-sur-mer: Walled town with its ramparts, abbey church, Hôtel-Dieu and medieval cellars; a fine half day, quiet after that.
gem:militello-in-val-di-catania: Baroque hill town of the Val di Noto with listed churches and a small museum; a quiet half-day stop.
gem:watford: Large commuter town whose listed sights lie in Harrow and other suburbs; useful for London trains, not a destination.
gem:nyons: Drôme town with its Roman bridge, the Rue des Grands Forts and its castle; Ventoux 24 km off, a half-day stop.
gem:pontarlier: High Jura town with the Porte Saint-Pierre, close to the Fort de Joux and mountain lakes; a base more than a sight.
gem:agira: Hilltop Sicilian borgo at 650 m above the Pozzillo lake, with a Canadian war cemetery nearby; few sights to hold more than a stop.
gem:sperlinga: Sicilian hill village of 600 in the Borghi più belli list at 750 m; its cathedral and municipal sights are in Nicosia, 5 km off.
gem:varallo-sesia: Sacro Monte di Varallo, a hill of frescoed chapels above the town, with Lake Orta 11 km away; a rewarding half day, quiet town below.
gem:pontivy: Central Brittany market town with old churches and chapels, within reach of Lake Guerlédan; quiet, a stop rather than a goal.
gem:san-benedetto-po: Po plain village grown around the great abbey of San Benedetto in Polirone; one fine monument, flat land around.
gem:greccio: Hill village with the Franciscan sanctuary of Greccio in its holm-oak wood, Lake Piediluco nine kilometres away; a half day at most.
gem:vietri-sul-mare: Listed village where the Amalfi coast begins, below Monte San Liberatore; the card's cathedral and museums belong to Salerno.
gem:san-casciano-dei-bagni: Listed Tuscan hill village known for its thermal baths, with Monte Amiata beyond; small, with churches as its sights.
gem:nusco: Hill village on the Irpinia ridge with a listed centre; abbeys and castles sit several kilometres away.
gem:eu: Normandy town with a château housing the Louis-Philippe museum and a Jesuit college chapel; Le Tréport is four kilometres off.
gem:nogent-le-rotrou: Perche town with a château and several old churches and an abbey; modest, a stop on the way.
gem:usseaux: Alpine hamlet at 1,400 m in the Orsiera park, 3 km from the vast Forte di Fenestrelle; quiet mountain base, tiny itself.
gem:ostana: Tiny Alpine village at 1,266 metres beneath Monviso; superb setting, but little to do beyond walking.
gem:etroubles: Listed alpine village at 1,270 m, 7 km below the Great St Bernard Pass and hospice; quiet once you have seen the lanes.
gem:suvereto: Tuscan village on the borghi list with a cloister and a fortress; the mining park and rocche are 5 to 6 km away.
gem:capalbio: Listed Maremma hill village with the Tarot Garden five kilometres away and Lake Burano nearby; small, best for a short stay.
gem:kastelruth: Borghi più belli village under the Schlern, with Sassolungo and Seceda within 15 km; a superb Dolomites base, few sights in the village.
gem:klausen: Listed Eisack valley town under the Säben monastery rock, with the Dolomites close; a fine half day, small for more.
gem:gradisca-d-isonzo: Listed fortified town near the Redipuglia war memorial and the Isonzo battlefields; for First World War history rather than beauty.
gem:troina: Listed hill town at 1,121 m above the Ancipa lake; few sights of its own to fill a day.
gem:bernay: Norman town in the Villes et Pays d'Art et d'Histoire network, with its abbey church and basilica; the card lists no more.
gem:stockport: Large Greater Manchester town whose listed sights and museums are mostly in Manchester, seven to nine kilometres away.
gem:issoire: Auvergne town around the Romanesque Abbatiale Saint-Austremoine; one great church in an otherwise ordinary town.
gem:villefranche-de-rouergue: Listed Aveyron town with its collegiate church and the Chartreuse Saint-Sauveur, Loc-Dieu abbey 8 km off; a good half day.
gem:trevoux: Old Saône-side town with the Dombes governor's house and a historic printing works; a short stroll near Lyon.
gem:cella-monte: Tiny listed hill village in Piedmont; the sights on the card are in towns seven kilometres away, so an hour is enough.
gem:volpedo: Listed small village in the Oltrepò hills, its named sights all in neighbouring villages; the card gives little reason to come.
gem:garessio: Upper Tanaro valley borgo at 620 m with mountain walks around; few sights, the royal Valcasotto lodge is 8 km away.
gem:bevagna: Listed walled Umbrian village with the church of San Silvestro and the civic museum; intact and calm, a half day.
gem:corciano: Listed hill village on Perugia's doorstep; the big sights are in Perugia nine kilometres away, so it suits a quiet base.
gem:montone: Umbrian hill borgo, among Italy's most beautiful villages, with a civic museum in San Francesco; an hour or two of lanes.
gem:soncino: Listed walled village on the Lombard plain with a dense old core; most named sights are neighbouring villages, a half day at most.
gem:bienno: Listed mountain village in the Valle Camonica, with Lago Moro 12 km away; old lanes for an hour, few named sights.
gem:ronciglione: Lazio village in the Borghi più belli list, 5 km from Lake Vico with Palazzo Farnese near; Lake Bracciano lies farther.
gem:santa-fiora: Listed village on the slopes of Monte Amiata with its parish church and Palazzo Sforza Cesarini; a good half day, then the mountain.
gem:montaione: Borghi più belli hill village in the Tuscan Valdelsa with a small archaeology museum; its main churches and museums lie 7 to 8 km away.
gem:cetona: Listed Tuscan hill village with Etruscan sites, a prehistory museum and Monte Cetona close by; quiet, near Chiusi's museum.
gem:cervignano-del-friuli: Friuli town used as a base for Aquileia, 7 km away; the borghi listing on the card looks misplaced, the town itself is plain.
gem:zungoli: Listed hill village at 657 m in the Italian south; the card names no sight, so little evidence to hold a visit.
gem:commercy: Meuse town on the list of Les Plus Beaux Détours de France, built round its château and a church; modest.
gem:saint-renan: Breton market town near Brest with the Kerloas menhir 4 km away; pleasant square, nothing that makes it a destination.
gem:ingria: Tiny Piedmont mountain hamlet of 11 people at 816 m in the Borghi più belli list; peaks and shrines lie 4 to 8 km away.
gem:bettona: Tiny listed Umbrian hill village; its museums and sights sit in neighbouring Deruta, so little to hold a stop of its own.
gem:nocera-umbra: Listed Umbrian hill town with its cathedral and Lombard jewellery finds, surrounded by mountain walking; little in the centre for long.
gem:atina: Listed hill village in the Comino valley below Monte Cairo, with a ducal palace; quiet and soon seen.
gem:pico: Hill borgo in southern Lazio, 8 km from the Pastena caves; a short stop, the village itself holds little.
gem:corinaldo: Listed Marche village ringed by its town walls, the Roman site of Suasa 6 km off; an hour's walk round.
gem:vitorchiano: Listed tufa hill village in Lazio with Villa Lante 5 km away and ancient beech forest on Monte Cimino; small.
gem:castiglione-di-garfagnana: Walled Garfagnana village under the Pania di Corfino, near the Verrucole fortress; quiet and quickly walked.
gem:stilo: Calabrian hill village with the Byzantine Cattolica, on the UNESCO tentative list, below Monte Consolino; remote and quickly seen.
gem:saint-jean-de-maurienne: Valley town with its cathedral, cloister and bishop's palace, ski resorts 5 to 7 km off; a stop on the way to the mountains.

gem:rocroi: Fortified Ardennes town with intact city walls and a Spanish house; quiet and compact, with little beyond an hour or two.
gem:acquasparta: Umbrian hill village in the borghi list, near the Roman ruins of Carsulae; a quiet stop rather than a base.
gem:garbagna: Tiny Piedmont village on the borghi list with a parish church; the castles on the card are 4 to 9 km away.
gem:mombaldone: Listed medieval hamlet of about a hundred people in the Langhe hills; a short walk round, with towers and parks only nearby.
gem:pontechianale: High Alpine village on its lake below Monviso, a base for walks to Col Agnel; few sights of its own.
gem:passignano-sul-trasimeno: Listed lakeside village on Lake Trasimeno with woods behind; a pleasant stop and lake base, few sights of its own.
gem:torgiano: Umbrian village in the Borghi più belli list known on the card for wine and olive-oil museums; small, with little else.
gem:morimondo: Listed village on the plain south-west of Milan, with Vigevano 7 km away; a quiet stop, an hour or so.
gem:monzambano: Listed Mincio village with Castellaro Lagusello 5 km away and Lake Garda close; quiet, little of its own.

gem:gangi: Listed Sicilian village at over 1,000 metres on Monte San Calogero; good views, but the named churches lie seven kilometres off.
gem:tagliacozzo: Abruzzo borgo più bello at 740 m with the church and convent of San Francesco; a good hour or two, little beyond.

gem:citta-sant-angelo: Listed Abruzzo hill town with the collegiate church of San Michele and the cloister of San Francesco, above the coast; a few hours suffice.
gem:bagnara-di-romagna: Small listed village around its Rocca fortress on the plain; an hour's stop, little else to hold you.
gem:sesto-al-reghena: Friuli village on the borghi list with a town hall and a parish house at its core; small, with a short list of sights.
gem:savignano-irpino: Listed hill village at 698 m with the Roman site of Aequum Tuticum 7 km off; quiet, with little to fill more than an hour.

gem:saint-claude: Jura valley town with an abbey cathedral and a few churches; little beyond that to keep a visitor.
gem:ambert: Auvergne town on the Les Plus Beaux Détours de France list with a town hall and a church; a paper mill is 4 km out.
gem:sainte-menehould: Listed Argonne town with the Notre-Dame-du-Château church and a war cemetery; little more to hold a visit.
gem:monteleone-d-orvieto: Small listed Umbrian hill village with its Teatro dei Rustici; quiet and intact, but an hour covers it.
gem:san-gemini: Listed Umbrian hill village round Piazza San Francesco, with the Roman city of Carsulae 3 km away; a fine hour or two, little more.
gem:castagnole-delle-lanze: Listed wine village in the hills near Barbaresco and Govone castle; its own sights are few.
gem:neive: Listed Langhe wine village close to Barbaresco; a fine stop on a wine route, but little to see for long.
gem:massa-martana: Listed Umbrian village with Santa Maria in Pantano and a stretch of the Via Flaminia 7 km off; a short visit.
gem:panicale: Umbrian hill village in the Borghi più belli list with a theatre; Lake Trasimeno lies 12 km away.
gem:sellano: Tiny listed hill village above the Vigi river toward the Valnerina; a short stop with little to see.
gem:vallo-di-nera: Tiny listed Umbrian hill village above the Valnerina; the card shows churches several kilometres away and little of its own.
gem:vogogna: Listed village with a Visconti castle and the Rocca, with Lake Mergozzo 15 km off; an hour or two in the village itself.
gem:fontainemore: Listed Aosta Valley hamlet below Monte Mars and the Mombarone, a walkers' base; tiny, with few sights in the village.
gem:sappada: Listed alpine village below Monte Peralba with mountain walks and the Wolayersee within reach; few sights in the village itself.
gem:varzi: Small Oltrepò Pavese borgo in the Borghi più belli list; the card names few sights, so it suits an hour's stroll.
gem:golferenzo: Tiny listed hamlet in the Oltrepò Pavese hills among other wine villages; half an hour covers it, little to hold more.
gem:pomponesco: Small Po-plain village in the Borghi più belli list; Viadana and Guastalla cathedral lie 5 to 6 km off and the card names little here.

gem:sassoferrato: Listed hill village with the Roman site of Sentinum and the Frasassi gorge 9 km away; a short visit rather than a stay.
gem:percile: Tiny listed village in the Monti Lucretili park, near Horace's villa; peaceful, with almost nothing to fill a day.

gem:varese-ligure: Listed inland Ligurian village in the Vara valley, under Monte Gottero; a quiet stop with walks, few sights to fill a day.
gem:rocca-san-giovanni: Listed hill village near the abbey of San Giovanni in Venere, Lanciano's churches 7 km away; a quiet stop, little to fill a day.
gem:campli: Listed hill village in Abruzzo whose named sights mostly sit in Teramo, 7 to 8 km away; a short visit on its own.
gem:vico-del-gargano: Listed Gargano hill village at the edge of the Foresta Umbra; the card names no sight in the village itself, so a short stop.
gem:ortignano-raggiolo: Listed Casentino village with a chestnut ecomuseum, 5 km from Poppi below the Pratomagno; quiet, an hour's stop.
gem:cordovado: Small listed Friuli village with a castle and old walls; Portogruaro's cathedral lies 9 km away, otherwise a short stop.
gem:polcenigo: Listed village below its castle, with the Cansiglio forest and Piancavallo close by; a pleasant stop, short on sights of its own.

gem:civita: Listed village above the Raganello gorge; beyond the gorge walk there is little to hold a second day.

gem:calascibetta: Sicilian hill village in the Borghi più belli list, with a Lombard castle and a geopark; Lake Pergusa lies 8 km away.
gem:campodimele: Hill village of 340 people with an orange-flag rating and mountains round it; little to do beyond a walk.
gem:barfleur: Listed fishing port with Saint-Nicolas church and the Gatteville lighthouse nearby; small, a few hours suffice.
gem:la-fleche: Loir town with the Prytanée military school, a covered market and the chapel of Notre-Dame des Vertus; a few hours, quiet.

gem:montecchio: Small Umbrian hill borgo with an Umbrian-Etruscan necropolis, 7 km from Lake Corbara; quiet, little to fill more than an hour.
gem:cocconato: Listed hilltop village in the Asti hills, near the abbey of Vezzolano; pleasant views, little to fill more than an hour.
gem:rosazza: Tiny listed mountain village at 882 m, the Oropa sanctuary and Monte Mucrone close by; quiet, with little to fill a day.
gem:guarene: Listed hill village a few kilometres from Alba and Barbaresco; a fine stop in wine country, though little holds you inside it.
gem:monte-castello-di-vibio: Listed Umbrian hill village with the little Teatro della Concordia; the main churches listed lie 8 km away.
gem:paciano: Listed hill village near Lake Trasimeno with a small theatre; the other churches and glass museum are five to seven kilometres off.
gem:preci: Borgo più bello in the Valnerina valley with mountain walks around; few sights of its own beyond an hour's stroll.
gem:fortunago: Tiny listed hill hamlet in the Oltrepò Pavese, a base for nearby castle villages; little of its own beyond a short walk.
gem:portobuffole: Tiny listed walled village on the Veneto plain, a wood nearby; an hour's stroll, as the sights on the card lie in other towns.
gem:montescudaio: Listed Tuscan borgo on a hill above the coast plain; the churches on the card lie in neighbouring villages, little to hold a day.
gem:boville-ernica: Listed hill village 3 km from Casamari Abbey and Monte San Giovanni Campano's castle; little of its own beyond a walk.
gem:acquapendente: Listed hill town with the church of the Holy Sepulchre and Lake Bolsena within reach; little to keep you beyond a short stop.

gem:frosolone: Molise hill village at 894 m known for its cutting-tools museum, with the Montagnola Molisana 5 km off; a short visit.
gem:sutera: Listed Sicilian hill village at 590 m under Monte San Paolino, with a nature reserve near; few sights of its own.
gem:salemi: Listed hill town at 446 m in western Sicily, the Santa Ninfa caves and Monte Polizzo nearby; the card names little in town.
gem:ferla: Listed hill village six kilometres from the rock tombs of Pantalica; a base for the necropolis, with little of its own.

gem:framura: Scattered Ligurian hamlets above the Bonassola coast, close to Levanto and the Cinque Terre; quiet, with few sights of its own.
gem:montecassiano: Hill village in the Marche on the borghi list; the sights named on the card are in Macerata, 7 km away.
gem:crecchio: Listed Abruzzo hill village whose ducal castle holds a museum of Byzantine and early medieval Abruzzo; an hour's visit, little else.

gem:acerenza: Listed hilltop village at 833 m crowned by its cathedral, with a diocesan museum; one fine church, an hour or two.
gem:morano-calabro: Listed Calabrian hill village with the church of Santa Maria Maddalena; striking from a distance, an hour or two inside.
gem:santa-severina: Calabrian hill village on the borghi list with a diocesan museum; the card names few sights, so the rating rests on the listing.
gem:cherasco: Orange Flag town in Piedmont with Pollenzo castle 4 km away and the Langhe 9 km off; small, a quiet half-day.
gem:mittelbergheim: Listed Alsace wine village next to Andlau and its abbey, with Mont Sainte-Odile 5 km away; an hour or two on foot.
gem:beuvron-en-auge: Listed Calvados village with its own manor; castles and churches lie three to nine kilometres off, so it suits a short stop.

gem:citerna: Listed hilltop village over the upper Tiber, close to Anghiari and Sansepolcro; its own sights are few.
gem:monteleone-di-spoleto: Borghi più belli mountain village in Valnerina with the church of San Francesco, Cascia 9 km away; remote, quickly seen.
gem:monterosso-almo: Listed Hyblaean hill village at 691 m among woods and hills; its named churches and castle lie 9 km away.

gem:valeggio-sul-mincio: Listed town on the Mincio, among moraine hills with Castellaro Lagusello 8 km off; the named sights are spread out.
gem:bugnara: Small listed Abruzzo village near the Sagittario gorges, with Sulmona's churches and museums 6 km away; quiet.
gem:visso: Listed Sibillini mountain village with a collegiate church and gorges close by; peaceful, though best as a base for the hills.
gem:gromo: Listed Alpine village with Pizzo Coca and lakes within reach; pretty and quiet, though best as a short stop.
gem:verucchio: Listed hill village with an archaeological museum, facing Monte Titano; most sights on the card are in San Marino.
gem:castro-dei-volsci: Listed hill village in the Ciociaria with the Pastena caves 8 km away; a short stop with little of its own.
gem:mondavio: Listed walled village with its Malatesta fortress tower and a history museum, Corinaldo's walls 7 km away; an hour, little more.

gem:castel-di-tora: Listed Sabine hill village near Monte Navegna and the Lago del Salto; few sights of its own to fill the day.
gem:magliano-sabina: Small Lazio village in the Borghi più belli list with a cathedral and archaeological museum; Roman Ocriculum lies 5 km off.
gem:oratino: Listed hill village at 795 m above the Biferno valley, near Campobasso's museums; quiet and small, an hour suffices.
gem:geraci-siculo: Listed Sicilian village at 1,077 m with a castle, several churches and evergreen oak woods nearby; remote and quiet.
gem:buccheri: Hill village where the listed sights are in Palazzolo Acreide, eight kilometres away; the village itself is a quiet stop.
gem:petralia-soprana: Listed mountain village at over 1,100 metres in Sicily, oak woods around; the named churches and castle lie eight kilometres off.
gem:montalbano-elicona: High Sicilian village under the castle of Frederick II, near the Argimusco rocks and Malabotta woods; remote and small.

gem:montelupone: Listed Marche hill village with a small theatre and town gate, within reach of Recanati; an hour's walk round.
gem:caramanico-terme: Listed spa village on the Maiella with the rock hermitages of San Bartolomeo and Santo Spirito nearby; a walkers' base, quiet sights.
gem:cisternino: Borghi più belli hill town in Apulia; the card's listed churches and palace sit 8 km away, so the village itself is a short stroll.
gem:venzone: Listed walled village with its Sant'Andrea cathedral, mountains and the Tagliamento close by; a fine stop, small for a day.
gem:rocca-imperiale: Listed hill village under its Swabian castle above the Ionian coast; an hour or two, the beaches are the longer stay.
gem:gesualdo: Listed Irpinia hill village with the Roman site of Aeclanum 8 km off; little in the village to fill more than an hour.
gem:summonte: Listed Partenio hill village with its Angevin tower, 4 km from Montevergine abbey; Avellino's museums are nearby, the village is small.
gem:monteprandone: Small listed hill village above the Adriatic coast near San Benedetto; pleasant lanes, but its named sights are mostly in the lower town.
gem:esanatoglia: Listed among Italy's most beautiful villages, with old churches and wooded hills close by; little to hold more than a short visit.
gem:charroux: Allier village on the list of France's most beautiful, with a few churches; the viaduct and château named on the card are some way off.
gem:saint-jean-d-angely: Listed Saintonge town around its old abbey church and the Pilori fountain; a short stop, quiet streets.
gem:louhans-chateaurenaud: Listed Bresse market town with its Hôtel-Dieu and old theatre; a pleasant market morning, little more.
gem:pont-croix: Listed small Breton town above the Goyen with the Maison du Marquisat, Audierne and beaches nearby; an hour's walk, quiet beyond.
gem:zavattarello: Listed hill village under the Dal Verme castle in the Oltrepò hills; a quiet stop, half an hour to an hour.
gem:rocca-pietore: Dolomite hamlet at 1,143 m under the Marmolada glacier, near Passo Giau and Malga Ciapela; a superb base, with little in the village itself.
gem:sant-ambrogio-di-valpolicella: Wine-country town in the Valpolicella hills on the borghi list, with a nature park nearby; a stop rather than a base.
gem:fiumalbo: Apennine village on the borghi list at 936 metres, with Monte Cimone and the Abetone ski area near; few sights of its own.
gem:camerata-cornello: Borghi più belli hamlet in the Val Brembana, San Pellegrino Terme 8 km away; a short detour up the valley.
gem:compiano: Walled borgo più bello crowned by the Castello di Compiano in the Taro valley; a fine hour or two, not a full day.
gem:gualtieri: Listed Po plain village with a municipal theatre and churches; the card shows little else to hold a stop.
gem:morro-d-alba: Marche hill village in the Borghi più belli list with a utensil museum and a shrine 5 km away; little else.
gem:collalto-sabino: Mountain village of 350 people at 980 metres on the borghi list; caves and a castle lie 5 to 7 km away.
gem:orvinio: Listed hill village at 840 m near the Monti Lucretili and Horace's Villa; little to see in the village itself.
gem:zuccarello: Ligurian medieval village in the Borghi più belli list; the Toirano Caves and mountain walks lie 6 to 7 km away.
gem:millesimo: Listed Ligurian inland village with the Santo Stefano monastery and Lake Osiglia 7 km off; an hour's stop on the way.
gem:sepino: Listed hill village 4 km above the Roman town of Saepinum at Altilia, with its theatre and museum; quiet, half a day covers it.
gem:pieve-tesino: Listed Trentino mountain village with the De Gasperi house museum and the Bigonda cave 6 km off; quiet, a short visit.
gem:oriolo: Listed hill village in northern Calabria; the card names no sight of its own, so it reads as a short stop.
gem:opi: Hilltop village at 1,250 m in the Borghi più belli list, beside Abruzzo National Park; Val Fondillo lies 5 km away.
gem:cipressa: Ligurian hill village in the Borghi più belli list with a fortress church; the sea and shrines lie 3 to 6 km off.
gem:diano-castello: Listed hill village above the Riviera with Capo Berta and beaches close by; pleasant for a stroll, few sights inside.
gem:brugnato: Ligurian village on the borghi list with an abbey co-cathedral and a diocesan museum; the sights are few.
gem:montecosaro: Listed Marche hill village with churches and a civic art gallery 4 km away in Civitanova; quiet and small.
gem:san-ginesio: Listed hill village at 680 m with a picture gallery and the Fiastrone gorge 9 km off; fine views, a short visit.
gem:pretoro: Listed Abruzzo village below the Majella, with San Liberatore abbey four kilometres off; a quiet base, short on sights of its own.
gem:specchia: Listed Salento village around Palazzo Risolo and its convents and churches, the coast 11 km off; a pleasant hour, little more.
gem:badolato: Listed Calabrian hill village at 240 m; the card names only a folk-instrument museum 5 km off, little to fill a visit.
gem:aieta: Listed Calabrian hill village behind the Maratea coast; Dino island and a sea grotto lie eight to nine kilometres away.
gem:altomonte: Listed Calabrian hill village with the Torre Pallotta and San Francesco da Paola church; a short visit with little else on record.
gem:monteverde: Small hill village in Campania on the borghi list; a folk museum and a lake nearby are all the card offers.
gem:brugnato-it: Small Val di Vara village with a co-cathedral and diocesan museum, 12 km from the Cinque Terre coast; little to hold a day.
gem:scapoli: Bandiera Arancione hill village in the Mainarde, near the abbey of San Vincenzo al Volturno; tiny, with little inside it.
gem:coaraze: Listed hill village at 650 m in the hills behind Nice; the churches and château listed are in other villages.
gem:ainhoa: Listed among France's most beautiful villages, one Basque street with its Assumption church, near the Sare caves; seen in an hour.
gem:arlempdes: Listed upland village at 1,076 m with Château de Beaufort and crater lakes such as Issarlès within 13 km; tiny, an hour on foot.
gem:cambo-les-bains: Basque spa village with Villa Arnaga and nearby Itxassou and Larressore; gentle and green, with few sights.
gem:l-argentiere-la-bessee: Alpine village at 1,224 m at the door of the Écrins National Park; a base for the mountains, plain in itself.
gem:combourg: Small town of character dominated by the Château de Combourg, with the Maison de la Lanterne; a good stop, little beyond the castle.
gem:cison-di-valmarino: Listed village under Castelbrando, with the Prosecco hills and Molinetto della Croda close by; a pretty stop, small for a day.
gem:pandino: Listed village on the Lombard plain with the Gradella hamlet 3 km off; a short stop on flat farmland.
gem:follina: Listed village at the foot of the UNESCO Prosecco hills, the Molinetto della Croda 6 km off; quiet, an hour or two.
gem:treia: Borghi più belli hill town in the Marche with the Accademia Georgica and San Francesco; handsome, but a few hours cover it.
gem:montefiore-conca: Listed hamlet under the Rocca Malatestiana, with the Onferno caves 5 km and San Marino's Monte Titano within 15 km; an hour's visit.
gem:san-giovanni-in-marignano: Listed plain village behind the Romagna coast, with Gradara castle 5 km away; little of its own beyond the walls.
gem:offagna: Listed hill village with the Rocca di Offagna fortress, Conero beaches 13 km off; little to hold more than a few hours.
gem:monte-grimano: Small hill village whose listed sights are all in San Marino, 8 km away; little of its own to stop for.
gem:borgo-valsugana: Listed Valsugana town on the Brenta, a base for the Caldonazzo and Levico lakes and Monte Ortigara; few sights of its own.
gem:castelvecchio-di-rocca-barbena: Tiny hill village among the Ligurian Borghi più belli, with the Toirano Caves 7 km away; very little to fill a day.
gem:fornelli: Listed Molise hill village, with the abbey of San Vincenzo al Volturno 7 km away; a quiet stop, the best lies nearby.
gem:pescocostanzo: Listed stone village at 1,395 m with the Santa Maria del Colle basilica and a lace museum, the Maiella 6 km off; small and quiet.
gem:alberona: Small listed Apulian hill village; the card shows a Byzantine tower 8 km away and forest hills, little of its own.
gem:roseto-valfortore: Borghi più belli hill village in the Daunian mountains near the Monte Cornacchia forest; remote and quiet, with few sights.
gem:frisanco: Tiny listed hill village above Val Colvera, close to the Barcis lake; its sights lie in nearby towns, so a short stop.
gem:travesio: Listed foothill village with the Cosa gorge and Monte Ciaurlec close by; good for walks, few sights of its own.
gem:trivignano-udinese: Flat Friulian village 6 km from star-shaped Palmanova, which is the real sight; little of its own to stop for.
gem:moresco: Listed hilltop hamlet of about 300 people in the Marche, Fermo's palaces and museums 8 km away; a short stop, little of its own.
gem:balazuc: Listed Ardèche village with its own church and a river beach at its foot; other sights are five to seven kilometres off.
gem:aigueze: Listed Gard village with the Saint-Marcel caves close by; a lovely short stop, little to fill a whole day.
gem:saint-veran: Listed mountain village in the Queyras, with Fort Queyras and old churches round about; a fine base, though sights are few.
gem:gourdon: Hill town in the Lot around the Église Saint-Pierre, with the painted Cougnac caves; a few hours, more stop than stay.
gem:quintin: Breton small town of character with a château, old houses and fragments of walls; a pleasant hour, then little more.
gem:navelli: Small Borghi più belli hill village in the Abruzzo; its listed churches and the San Pietro ad Oratorium abbey are 5 to 8 km out.
gem:macerata-feltria: Listed Montefeltro village near the Sasso Simone and Simoncello park, Monte Titano 14 km away; quiet hills, few sights.
gem:bleggio-superiore: Trentino village in the Borghi più belli list; Stenico Castle and the Fiavè pile-dwelling site lie 4 km away, lakes beyond.
gem:bondone: Borghi più belli mountain village above Lake Idro, with the Rocca d'Anfo nearby; a fine lake view, little inside it.
gem:vigo-di-fassa: Dolomite village under the Catinaccio, close to the Vajolet towers, with a Ladin museum; a fine walking base, a plain resort village.
gem:san-marco-d-alunzio: Listed Sicilian hill village with old churches, near the rock walls of Rocche del Crasto; little to fill more than an hour or two.
gem:pietramontecorvino: Small listed Apulian hill village; the card names only surrounding hills and a lake, with no sights of its own.
gem:bovino: Listed hill village in the Daunia mountains with a cathedral and a diocesan museum; an hour or two, little more.
gem:irsina: Listed Basilicata hill town with its underground Bottini and a civic museum; remote, and an hour or two covers it.
gem:montefiore-dell-aso: Listed hill village at 412 m with the church and museum of San Francesco; a quiet hour, not a full day.
gem:servigliano: Small listed village in the Marche hills; the sights on the card lie in towns seven to nine kilometres away, an hour is enough.
gem:chateauneuf: Listed Burgundy village around its own castle, with Commarin castle four kilometres away; small and well kept, best for a short visit.
gem:moncontour: Listed Breton village with old town houses and the Saint-Mathurin church; a short stroll with little beyond.
gem:neris-les-bains: Small spa town with a thermal baths and a casino; the castle and churches on the card are in Montluçon, seven kilometres away.
gem:saint-amand-les-eaux: Spa town with a baroque abbey tower, the Wallers-Arenberg mine of the coal basin seven kilometres away; a few hours at most.
gem:mazamet: Former wool town at the foot of the Montagne Noire, near the Lac des Montagnès; a few old churches, little to hold a day.
gem:moncontour-fr: Small Breton village of character with the church of Saint-Mathurin and old townhouses; an hour or two, little more.
gem:scandolara-ravara: Listed village on the Po plain whose named sights are other villages around it; quiet, with little to hold a stop.

gem:foussais-payre: Listed small Vendée village with châteaux such as La Citardière nearby; quiet and pretty, but little of its own on record.
