gem:storrington: Quiet West Sussex market town below the South Downs, with Amberley Castle and the Rings nearby; little in the town itself.
gem:worth: Kent village near Richborough Castle 4 km off and the Deal and Walmer castles; a base for them, nothing of its own.
gem:giglio-castello: Listed hilltop village at 405 m on the island of Giglio, with its Aldobrandeschi fortress and towers; a fine view, an hour inside the walls.
gem:poffabro: Listed stone hamlet in Val Colvera, with the Cellina gorge 9 km away; a short, quiet visit with little else in the village.
gem:san-donato-in-poggio: Listed Chianti hill village of old stone houses and small churches; Tavarnelle's sacred art museum is close, and the pace is slow.
gem:santa-cruz-de-tenerife: Port city with the Auditorio de Tenerife, Anaga's mountains 7 km away and La Laguna next door; the centre itself is ordinary.
gem:dunkirk: Channel port city with a lighthouse, belfry-style tower and a historic ship; plain in feel, with beaches a short drive off.
gem:portsmouth: Naval harbour city with HMS Victory, the Mary Rose and Spinnaker Tower; a plain urban fabric around them.
gem:corinth: Plain modern town 6 to 7 km from Ancient Corinth and the Acrocorinth citadel; a base for the ruins, not a place in itself.
gem:reutlingen: Swabian city with the Marienkirche and the Achalm hill above; a few hours at most, mostly modern beyond the church.
gem:terrassa: Industrial city with the church complex of Sant Pere and a textile museum, Montserrat within reach; the rest is workaday.
gem:llanfairpwllgwyngyll: Anglesey village by the Menai and Britannia bridges and the Bryn Celli Ddu tomb; known for its long name, worth only a stop.
gem:bradford: Victorian City Hall, the cathedral and Cartwright Hall, with Saltaire 5 km off; an uneven, rundown centre.
gem:recklinghausen: Ruhr city with an icon museum and Schloss Herten 6 km away; ordinary streets and little to draw a visitor.
gem:verbania: Lake Maggiore town with Villa Taranto gardens, Isola Madre and Mottarone nearby; the lake and gardens carry it, the town less.
gem:lens: Northern French mining town in a UNESCO-listed basin, with spoil tips and the Vimy Memorial 7 km away; plain fabric.
gem:kopavogur: Residential town next to Reykjavík; every sight on the card, from Hallgrímskirkja to the museums, lies in the capital.
gem:hafnarfjorður: Harbour town on lava fields south of Reykjavík with the Hafnarborg art centre; a few hours, few reasons to stay.
gem:brixen: Cathedral town with its diocesan museum, Neustift abbey 3 km away and Dolomite peaks such as Seceda near; a fine base, compact centre.
gem:verdun: Base for the Douaumont Ossuary, the forts and the Trench of Bayonets; the town's own cathedral is a short visit.
gem:fiumicino: Coastal town 3 km from Portus and 5 km from Ostia Antica; the ruins draw, the town itself is plain.
gem:saint-germain-en-laye: Royal château town with the National Archaeological Museum and Villa Savoye 5 km away; a well-off suburb feel.
gem:ventimiglia: Border town with a Roman theatre, near the Hanbury Gardens and Balzi Rossi caves; the town itself is workaday.
gem:frascati: Hill town above Rome with Lake Albano and the Castelli Romani park close by; its sights are mostly outside the town.
gem:αργος: Larissa castle and an archaeological museum, with Tiryns seven kilometres away; a workaday town that Nafplio outshines as a base.
gem:quartu-sant-elena: Large seaside suburb of Cagliari beside Poetto beach and a flamingo wetland park; the sights on the card are in Cagliari.
gem:kranj: Small old town with St Cantianus church and Khislstein manor, Škofja Loka 9 km away; pleasant, but a stop on the way to the Alps.
gem:agde: Old river town with a fortified cathedral and bishop's palace, near the Cap d'Agde beaches; the core is small and worn.
gem:katerini: Greek city at the foot of Mount Olympus, listed 25 km away, with a folklore museum; the beaches are 7 km off.
gem:manfredonia: Apulian port city at the Gargano; the archaeological museum is in town, while Monte Sant'Angelo lies 9 km away.
gem:san-benedetto-del-tronto: Adriatic beach town near the Sentina reserve and the Piceno coast; a summer resort with few sights of its own.
gem:ponte-buggianese: Flat Valdinievole town; its listed sights are in Montecatini, Pescia and Buggiano Castello 5 to 9 km away.
gem:grottaferrata: Castelli Romani town with the abbey church of Santa Maria, Lake Albano 6 km and Lake Nemi 10 km away; a day trip only.
gem:aubagne: Provençal town with the Foreign Legion museum and penitents' chapels, the Calanques about ten kilometres away; plain in itself.
gem:formia: Coastal town with a Roman cistern and an archaeological museum, next to Gaeta; a modern seafront with little to hold a day.
gem:chiavari: Ligurian seaside town with a cathedral, an archaeological museum and Fieschi basilica nearby; pleasant, though not a stand-out.
gem:loreto: Hill town built around the Santuario della Santa Casa and its tall bell tower; pilgrims fill it, little else holds a second day.
gem:monfalcone: Town near First World War battlefields and the Duino cliffs; plain in itself, so a stop rather than a stay.
gem:libourne: Wine-trade town on the Dordogne, with Saint-Émilion's monolithic church and great châteaux 7 km away; a base more than a sight.
gem:ruda-slaska: Industrial Silesian city with coal mines and the Guido mine museum nearby; no centre that draws a visitor.
gem:albenga: Ligurian town with a Roman amphitheatre area, an early Christian basilica and a Roman ship museum; compact and low-key.
gem:haarlemmermeer: A drained-lake municipality around Schiphol with the Cruquius pumping museum; a place to sleep near the airport, not a destination.
gem:benalmadena: Costa del Sol resort with beaches, Selwo Marina and Tivoli World; built-up coast with little old fabric.
gem:san-sebastian-de-los-reyes: Commuter city on Madrid's northern edge whose named sights are a few chapels and parks nearby; no reason to visit.
gem:jouy-en-josas: Leafy suburb 5 km from the Palace of Versailles and the Trianons; the great sights are in Versailles, not here.
gem:pietrasanta: Small town between the Apuan hills and the coast, with a clock tower and forts and villas nearby; pleasant, but few sights of its own.
gem:carpentras: Provençal market town with a Roman arch, its cathedral and the Inguimbertine library, Mont Ventoux in view; pleasant but a half day.
gem:l-abergement-clemenciat: Small Ain village with no sight of its own; the church and château of Châtillon-sur-Chalaronne lie 4 to 5 km away.
gem:sagunto: Valencian town crowned by the long Castell de Sagunt above a Roman theatre; strong history, a modern sprawl below.
gem:molsheim: Alsace town with its Charterhouse and Jesuit church; pleasant for an hour, outshone by wine villages close by.
gem:fasano: Apulian town near the Egnazia archaeological area and the Fasanolandia park; a base for the coast, little in town.
gem:hengelo: Dutch industrial city with a station and little of its own to see; Twickel and the Rijksmuseum Twenthe lie 5 to 8 km out.
gem:sarzana: Ligurian town with a cathedral and two fortresses, Firmafede and Castracani; a handsome medieval core, though quickly seen.
gem:frontignan: Lagoon-side town with Saint Paul's church and the penitents' chapel, beaches nearby; a plain place to pass through.
gem:oliena: Mountain village below Monte Corrasi, with the Tiscali nuraghic site and Nuoro's museums near; a good base, few sights of its own.
gem:orbetello: Town on a spit in the Orbetello lagoon, near Roman Cosa and the Feniglia dune; fine setting, a modest old centre.
gem:lievin: Former mining town 5 km from the Vimy memorial and Notre-Dame de Lorette; the war sites are the visit, the town is not.
gem:limone-sul-garda: Lakeside village under steep cliffs on Lake Garda, Lago di Ledro and Monte Baldo within reach; small, and busy with day visitors.
gem:nettuno: Lazio seaside town with the Forte Sangallo and the Sicily–Rome American war cemetery; a beach and memorial stop, little more.
gem:magomadas: Small hill village above Bosa Marina beach, Serravalle castle 4 km away; a quiet base, the sights are in Bosa.
gem:sagama: Tiny inland Sardinian village of 213 people; every sight listed belongs to Bosa, 7 km away.
gem:genzano-di-roma: Castelli Romani town above Lake Nemi, 1.4 km away, with Lake Albano 5 km off and the Nemi ships museum; a leafy base near Rome.
gem:riva-del-garda: Lake Garda's northern shore under steep mountains, with the Varone waterfall 3 km off and Lake Ledro near; a busy, mixed town.
gem:purmerend: Commuter city near the Beemster polder and Waterland meadows; the draws lie outside town, little reason to stay.
gem:avigliana: Piedmont town between two lakes, with the abbey of Sant'Antonio di Ranverso 4 km away; a pleasant base near Turin.
gem:suni: Inland village 4 km above Bosa with a parish church; the castle, cathedral and beach all belong to Bosa.
gem:pescia: Valdinievole town near Villa Garzoni and the Pinocchio park, with Montecatini 7 km off; the town itself is modest.
gem:flussio: Tiny Sardinian hill village with Bosa's castle and the Temo valley 4 to 8 km away; little of its own.
gem:tergu: Sardinian hamlet with the Romanesque Nostra Signora de Tergu, Castelsardo's Doria castle 6 km off; an hour's stop.
gem:colle-di-val-d-elsa: Tuscan town with a crystal museum and an archaeology museum, San Gimignano 8 km away; a base more than a sight in its own right.
gem:agropoli: Coastal town 8 km from the Greek temples of Paestum, a good base for them; the card names little in the town itself.
gem:tinnura: Tiny Sardinian village 5 km from Bosa, with its castle and beach; a short stop, as the card names nothing of its own.
gem:tresnuraghes: Small Planargia village above the coast; the castle and churches on the card belong to Bosa, 5 km away.
gem:locri: Calabrian coast town 3 km from the Greek site of Locri Epizephyrii and its museum, with Gerace near; the modern town itself is plain.
gem:mino-de-medinaceli: High, tiny Soria village whose only named sights are in Medinaceli, 7 km away; nothing to stop for here.
gem:nuragus: Sardinian hill village whose Nuragic sites, Su Nuraxi among them, lie seven to nine kilometres away; a quiet base only.
gem:elefsina: Industrial Attica town with the Telesterion sanctuary and an archaeological museum, named a European Capital of Culture; a rough setting.
gem:rocca-di-papa: Hill town at 680 m under Monte Cavo, lakes Albano and Nemi within 5 km; a fine viewpoint and base, few sights inside.
gem:chianciano-terme: Spa town 5 km from Montepulciano, whose churches and palaces make up the named sights; a place to sleep, not to see.
gem:setzu: Tiny Sardinian village close to Su Nuraxi and the Giara plateau, five kilometres off; a quiet base with little in the village.
gem:turri: Tiny Sardinian village six kilometres from the Su Nuraxi nuraghe and near the Giara plateau; a base, not a sight itself.
gem:beligneux: Plain commune on the Ain plain; its listed sights are in Montluel and Pérouges, several kilometres away, so no reason to stop.
gem:villanovafranca: Small Marmilla farming village 7 km from the Su Nuraxi nuraghe; the sight lies elsewhere, the village offers little.
gem:ussaramanna: Tiny Sardinian village that serves as a base for the nuraghe sites nearby; the village itself is brief.
gem:eraclea: Reclaimed-land comune near the Laguna del Mort and Adriatic beaches; the inland town has nothing to see.
gem:grado: Lagoon town with the basilica of Sant'Eufemia and its baptistery, on the Marano-Grado lagoon; beach resort beyond the old core.
gem:montresta: Small Sardinian hill village near Bosa, with the Temo valley and coast close by; its sights lie eight to ten kilometres away.
gem:roseto-degli-abruzzi: Adriatic beach town with Villa Clemente and a sailors' memorial; its listed churches and galleries lie 7 to 9 km away.
gem:fondi: Plain town with a baronial castle and old churches, the Lago di Fondi 7 km off; little to keep a visitor long.
gem:porto-empedocle: Working port town, base for Scala dei Turchi and the Valley of the Temples at five to six kilometres; itself plain.
gem:ladispoli: Seaside commuter town with the Etruscan necropolis of Cerveteri 7 km inland; the town itself offers little beyond the beach.
gem:katwijk: Dutch beach town with dunes at Berkheide; the Leiden museums listed lie 6 to 7 km away, not in the town.
gem:velez-malaga: Axarquía town with a castle, the Palacio de Beniel and old churches; a pleasant hour or two, beaches at Torre del Mar.
gem:chiclana-de-la-frontera: Beach town by the Bahía de Cádiz park, Camposoto and Sancti Petri beaches 6 to 8 km off; a beach base, little in town.
gem:certaldo: Tuscan town 9 km from San Gimignano's towers, with a sacred art museum of its own; a base more than a sight.
gem:omegna: Town at the head of Lake Orta below the Mottarone, a base for Orta's Sacro Monte 9 km away; little to see in town itself.
gem:hoogeveen: Drenthe town with a Grote Kerk and the Museum de 5000 Morgen; the card names little else, and the setting is flat.
gem:genuri: Tiny Sardinian village on the edge of the Giara plateau; Su Nuraxi and museums are seven to nine kilometres off.
gem:fosdinovo: Hill village crowned by the Castello Malaspina, with Sarzana and the Ligurian beaches close by; a short visit beyond the castle.
gem:pauli-arbarei: Small Marmilla village 8 km from the Su Nuraxi nuraghe and near the Giara di Siddi; a base at best, little in the village.
gem:montevarchi: Valdarno market town with a palaeontology museum and Masaccio's house nearby; ordinary beside other Tuscan towns, an hour or two.
gem:la-chapelle-du-chatelard: Small Dombes commune whose named sights are in Châtillon-sur-Chalaronne and Villars-les-Dombes, 7 to 9 km away; nothing to stop for.
gem:arromanches-les-bains: Seaside village on the Normandy landing coast, Gold Beach 4 km off and the Longues-sur-Mer battery near; moving, but busy and soon seen.
gem:poissy: Le Corbusier's Villa Savoye is the draw, with Saint-Germain-en-Laye 5 km away; a suburban town, an hour or two.
gem:settimo-vittone: Lower Aosta valley village among terraced vineyards, near the Ivrea lakes; a quiet stop, most sights lie 5 to 8 km away.
gem:delfzijl: Port town with a few churches and a water gate; little to see, though the village churches around reward a short drive.
gem:nemi: Village on the rim above crater Lake Nemi, with the Museum of Nemi's ships and Lake Albano 5 km away; half a day suffices.
gem:san-giuliano-terme: Spa village 6 km from Pisa's Piazza del Duomo; a quiet base for Pisa, with little of its own on the card.
gem:monte-san-savino: Tuscan hill town with the walls and squares of Lucignano six kilometres away; a pleasant stop, most named sights lie outside it.
gem:martina-franca: Baroque hill town at the heart of the Itria Valley, with its cathedral and Palazzo Ducale; a rewarding half day, Alberobello near.
gem:wageningen: Dutch university town on the Rhine with Doorwerth Castle 8 km away; student life, but a plain centre.
gem:fucecchio: Lower Arno town with a collegiate church and civic museum; the better sights are in nearby towns, not a reason to stop.
gem:meppel: Ordinary Drenthe market town with a mill and lakes nearby; nothing to hold a visitor for a day.
gem:marostica: Veneto town with city walls and two castles and a string of museums; compact, a half day.
gem:borgo-san-lorenzo: Mugello town beside Lake Bilancino with Medici villas at Cafaggiolo and Trebbio 7 to 8 km out; the town itself is ordinary.
gem:san-vincenzo: Tuscan beach resort near the Rimigliano coastal park; its own sights are a tower and war memorials.
gem:gardone-riviera: Lake Garda resort on the western shore, home of d'Annunzio's Vittoriale degli Italiani; one great sight, then a quiet lakefront.
gem:castel-del-monte-it: Listed stone village high on the Gran Sasso plateau, 5 km from Rocca Calascio castle; quiet, with little to do in the village itself.
gem:mezzano: Village in the Primiero valley on the borghi list, with churches and climbing crags; mountains such as Monte Pavione are 5 to 6 km off.
gem:crespi-d-adda: UNESCO-listed hamlet by the Adda, seen whole in one walk; striking, but an hour or two is enough.
gem:kuhmo: Remote Kainuu town with an arts centre, a Winter War museum and the Petola nature centre; far to travel for little.
gem:la-flotte: Listed island harbour village with Fort de La Prée and an abbey ruin, Saint-Martin's Vauban walls 4 km off; little to fill a full day.
gem:saint-savin: UNESCO-listed abbey church of Saint-Savin-sur-Gartempe; one great monument in a small village, an hour or two.
gem:lliria: Valencian town named a UNESCO Creative City, with a Roman baths site and Iberian Edeta; the centre is modest.
gem:winslow: Buckinghamshire market town with Winslow Hall and Claydon House close by; pleasant, but an hour covers it.
gem:borgo-valbelluna: Listed Piave valley comune with Zumelle castle and the Brent de l'Art gorge near; little to keep you beyond an hour.
gem:klirou: Cypriot hill village on a tentative heritage list; Fikardou, seven kilometres away, is the draw and little else is here.
